templates.name: api_nano_banana_2_1_t2i
templates.title: Nano Banana 2.1: Text to Image
templates.description: Generate images from text prompts using Nano Banana 2.1, Google's fast Gemini-based image model, delivering one finished image with no input files required. Ideal for brand marketing posters, e-commerce product visuals, and IP character series.

templates.name: image_z_image_turbo
templates.title: Z-Image-Turbo: Text to Image
templates.description: An Efficient Image Generation Foundation Model with Single-Stream Diffusion Transformer, supports English & Chinese.

templates.name: image_qwen_image_2_1_image_edit
templates.title: Qwen Image 2.1: Image Edit
templates.description: Edit images with Qwen-Image-2.1 by feeding two reference images through a single checkpoint that handles both generation and editing, then comparing the result against the original. Ideal for character-consistent edits, product cutout compositing with real transparency, and style-transfer passes at native 2K.

templates.name: image_qwen_image_2_1_t2i
templates.title: Qwen Image 2.1: Text to Image
templates.description: Generate images from text prompts with Qwen Image 2.1, the latest open-weight Qwen-Image model, producing a single 1024×1024 image over 25 sampling steps. Generation and instruction-based editing share one model with native 2K output, professional typography, and alpha-channel support. Ideal for poster and layout design, transparent asset creation, and rapid concept visualization.

templates.name: image_krea2_turbo_t2i
templates.title: Krea-2: Text to Image
templates.description: Generate images from text prompts using Krea 2, a foundation model built for aesthetic quality and creative control. It focuses on rendering expressive and artistic styles. Ideal for concept art exploration, visual brainstorming, and creating stylized imagery for design projects.

templates.name: image_qwen_image_edit_2509
templates.title: Qwen Image Edit 2509
templates.description: Advanced image editing with multi-image support, improved consistency, and ControlNet integration.

templates.name: image_qwen_image_2_1_turbo_image_edit
templates.title: Qwen Image 2.1 Turbo: Image edit
templates.description: Edit images with Qwen-Image-2.1 by feeding two reference images through a single checkpoint that handles both generation and editing, then comparing the result against the original. Ideal for character-consistent edits, product cutout compositing with real transparency, and style-transfer passes at native 2K

templates.name: image_qwen_image_2_1_turbo_t2i
templates.title: Qwen Image 2.1 Turbo: Text to Image
templates.description: Generate images from text prompts with Qwen Image 2.1 Turbo, the 8-step accelerated checkpoint, producing a single 1024×1024 image in 8 sampling steps. Same model family with native 2K output, professional typography, and alpha-channel support, plus an optional Qwen 3.5 prompt enhancer. Ideal for poster and layout design, transparent asset creation, and rapid concept visualization.

templates.name: image_minimax_h3_t2i
templates.title: MiniMax H3: Text to Image
templates.description: Generate a single still image from a text prompt with MiniMax H3, an omni-modal video model used here for its first-frame decode. No file inputs required: the graph samples an empty latent and decodes it through the H3 video VAE. Best suited to a single subject with a defined light source and a simple or blurred background.

templates.name: image_moss_image_t2i
templates.title: MOSS-Image: Text to Image
templates.description: Generate an image from a text prompt with MOSS-Image, an open-weights model that reads a full scene caption and returns one finished image. A prompt upsampler expands a short request into that caption first, so a one-line description is enough. Ideal for editorial photography, product shots, and concept art.

templates.name: image_moss_image_base_t2i
templates.title: MOSS-Image Base: Text to Image
templates.description: Generate an image from a text prompt with the MOSS-Image base checkpoint, which reads a full scene caption and returns one finished image. The prompt upsampler expands a short request into that caption first. Use it for fine-tuning experiments and comparisons with the instruction-tuned checkpoint.

templates.name: image_moss_image_t2i_bboxes
templates.title: MOSS-Image: Layout-Guided Text to Image
templates.description: Generate an image from a text prompt plus a layout drawn in Create Bounding Boxes. Each box carries its own caption, and text boxes also render their text, so MOSS-Image places every element where you put it. Useful for posters, packaging shots, and any composition where placement matters.

templates.name: image_moss_image_base_t2i_bboxes
templates.title: MOSS-Image Base: Layout-Guided Text to Image
templates.description: Generate an image from a text prompt plus a layout drawn in Create Bounding Boxes, using the MOSS-Image base checkpoint. Each box carries its own caption and text boxes render their text. Useful for comparing the base and instruction-tuned checkpoints on the same layout.

templates.name: image_moss_image_edit
templates.title: MOSS-Image: Image Edit LoRA
templates.description: Edit a photo with a short instruction using MOSS-Image and its edit LoRA: the instruction and the source image are encoded together, so the sampler redraws the same frame and only the described change is applied. Colour, material, outfit and background swaps keep the face, hair, pose and framing intact, and a Compare Images node shows the source next to the result.

templates.name: image_moss_image_color_depth_control
templates.title: MOSS-Image: Color & Depth Control
templates.description: Re-pose and re-style a reference photo with MOSS-Image: the graph estimates the reference's geometry with MoGe 3, then generates a new image that keeps the pose, framing and silhouette while the prompt decides the character, wardrobe, setting and light. A color/depth control adapter LoRA makes the model follow the estimated map, and the color map socket is there for region-painted layouts.

templates.name: api_bria_fibo2_t2i
templates.title: Bria: FIBO 2.0 Text to Image
templates.description: Generate an image from a text prompt with Bria FIBO 2.0, one model for both generation and editing. It is trained on structured VGL captions, so a detailed poster-style brief is followed closely, exact wording is rendered literally, and the node also returns that structured prompt so the same image can be rebuilt or refined from JSON. Ideal for editorial covers, posters and typography-led layouts.

templates.name: image_flux3_klein_image_edit
templates.title: FLUX 3 Image Klein: Image Edit
templates.description: Edit an existing image with FLUX 3 Image Klein by supplying one input image and two text prompts, producing one refined output alongside a side-by-side comparison view. Ideal for targeted retouching, style adjustments, and detail corrections that preserve the original composition.

templates.name: image_flux3_klein_distilled_image_edit
templates.title: FLUX 3 Image Klein Distilled: Image Edit
templates.description: Edit an existing image with FLUX 3 Image Klein by pairing one input image with one text prompt, producing a single edited result and a side-by-side comparison view. Ideal for targeted retouching, restyling a photo, or swapping details while keeping the rest of the scene intact.

templates.name: image_flux3_klein_t2i
templates.title: FLUX 3 Image Klein: Text to Image
templates.description: Generate images from text prompts using FLUX 3 Image Klein, producing a single saved image with no file inputs required. Ideal for concept art, marketing visuals, and rapid prototyping of scene ideas from written descriptions.

templates.name: image_flux3_klein_distilled_t2i
templates.title: FLUX 3 Image Klein Distilled: Text to Image
templates.description: Generate images from text prompts using the distilled FLUX 3 Image Klein model, which runs efficiently in 15 sampling steps with no classifier-free guidance. Just describe what you want and receive one finished image. Ideal for rapid concept art, marketing visuals, and everyday creative ideation where speed matters.

templates.name: api_google_nano_banana2_image_edit
templates.title: Nano Banana 2: Image Edit
templates.description: Upload an image and a text prompt to edit it. Generate a new image that modifies the original based on your instructions, maintaining subject consistency and high visual fidelity.

templates.name: api_krea3_image_edit

templates.title: Image Upscale: Nano Banana Pro
templates.description: Upload an AI-generated image to upscale and enhance details. Generate a 4K output with improved sharpness and coherence using Nano Banana Pro.

templates.name: templates_doc_workbox_klein_9b_image_extend
templates.title: Image Outpainting: FLUX.2 Klein 9B
templates.description: Use the FLUX.2 Klein 9B model to intelligently extend and expand image content. Input an image to generate seamless outpainting and extended compositions.

templates.name: image_qwen_image_2_1_background_removal
templates.title: Remove Background: Qwen Image 2.1
templates.description: Remove image backgrounds with Qwen Image 2.1, which natively supports 2K output and RGBA transparency for direct transparent results. It takes 1 input image and returns 1 background-free image plus a comparison view showing the before and after. Ideal for e-commerce product photos, profile pictures, and marketing graphics needing clean cutouts.

templates.name: utility_seedvr2_3b_int8_upscale_image
templates.title: Image Upscale: SeedVR2 3B Int8
templates.description: Upscale images using SeedVR2 3B Int8, a one-step diffusion-based video restoration model that produces high-quality results with improved temporal consistency. Ideal for restoring degraded footage, upscaling low-resolution videos, and enhancing archival media.

templates.name: utility_image_segment_sam3
templates.title: Image Segmentation: SAM3
templates.description: Use the SAM3 model to segment the main subject or content from a photo or image, isolating specific objects or regions. Input an image and receive a segmented mask output.

templates.name: utility_moge3_geometry_estimation
templates.title: Geometry Estimation: MoGe 3
templates.description: Estimate fine-detailed geometry from a single image with MoGe 3, the sparse-volumetric refinement version of MoGe. It lifts a coarse point map onto a sparse voxel shell and refines depth with lightweight sparse 3D convolutions, keeping thin structures and depth discontinuities that image-space decoders blur. Ships with the ViT-L checkpoint; the ViT-G file is selectable in the same Load MoGe Model dropdown for higher fine-detail accuracy. Takes 1 image input and outputs 1 depth map and 1 normal map.

templates.name: image_qwen_image_layered
templates.title: Layer Decomposition: Qwen-Image-Layered
templates.description: Decompose an image into editable RGBA layers for high-fidelity recolor, replace, resize, and reposition workflows using Qwen-Image-Layered.

templates.name: utility_birefnet_remove_background
templates.title: Remove Background: BiRefNet
templates.description: Upload an image with any background. Generate a version with the background removed and a precision segmentation mask.

templates.name: utility_depth_anything3_image_depth_estimation
templates.title: Depth Estimation: Depth Anything 3
templates.description: Upload 1 image. Generate a depth map using Depth Anything 3 and view a side-by-side comparison of the original and depth output. Ideal for 3D scene reconstruction, AR/VR asset preparation, and visual effects depth passes.

templates.name: api_bria_genfill
templates.title: Inpainting: Bria Generative Fill
templates.description: Use Bria's Generative Fill API to regenerate a specific region of an image while keeping everything outside the mask pixel-perfect unchanged. Paint a mask over the target area, write a detailed prompt for the replacement content, and compare the before/after side-by-side before exporting. Ideal for product photography corrections, object removal or replacement, and creative compositing where precise control over the edited region matters.

templates.name: api_bria_expand_image
templates.title: Image Outpainting: Bria
templates.description: Expand an image beyond its original borders using Bria's outpainting API, generating new surrounding content that matches the original lighting, perspective, and texture while leaving the source untouched. Choose from preset aspect ratios, custom dimensions, or manual canvas placement, with optional text prompts to guide the expansion direction or an auto-generated prompt when left blank. Ideal for extending compositions for print layouts, creating panoramic versions of existing photos, and adapting artwork to new formats or social media dimensions.

templates.name: utility_bria_remove_image_background
templates.title: Remove Background: Bria
templates.description: Upload an image to automatically remove its background using the Bria API. The workflow processes the request asynchronously and returns the edited image with a transparent background.

templates.name: utility_bria_increase_resolution
templates.title: Image Upscale: Bria Increase Resolution
templates.description: Upscale any image to higher resolutions using Bria's dedicated resolution enhancement API, which preserves original content without adding new details or regenerating the image. The workflow accepts a single input image and produces one enhanced, higher-resolution output, supporting JPEG and PNG files in RGB, RGBA, or CMYK color modes up to a maximum area of 8192x8192 pixels. Built-in content moderation scans both the input image and generated output to ensure safe, policy-compliant processing. Ideal for preparing images for print, enlarging photos for digital display, or increasing resolution of assets for professional design work.

templates.name: api_clarity_ai_crystal_upscale
templates.title: Clarity AI: Crystal Upscaler
templates.description: Upscale and enhance images with the precision-focused Crystal model, preserving real detail while adding resolution. Takes one image in and returns one upscaled image plus a side-by-side comparison view. Ideal for portraits, product shots, and print-ready enlargements where faithful detail matters.

templates.name: api_magnific_image_upscale_precise
templates.title: Image Upscale: Magnific Precise
templates.description: Upload an image to precisely upscale it using the Magnific model, generating a high-resolution version with enhanced detail.

templates.name: api_bytedance_seedream_5_0_layer_separation
templates.title: Layer Decomposition: Seedream 5.0 Pro
templates.description: Split any image into independent, editable layers — subject, product, background, and text — with a single text instruction using Seedream 5.0 Pro. A single poster can yield 10+ layers, with design-grade text separation supporting multilingual headlines and CJK fonts. Ideal for brand design, e-commerce asset creation, and layout iteration.

templates.name: utility_topaz_illustration_upscale
templates.title: Image Upscale: Topaz Illustration
templates.description: Upload an illustration to upscale using Topaz. Generate a smooth, stylized image with accurate colors, though some artifacts may appear.

templates.name: api_topaz_image_enhance_bloom2
templates.title: Image Upscale: Topaz Bloom 2
templates.description: Enhance AI-generated images with Bloom 2, a creative upscaling model that adds new detail, texture, and visual elements while offering a Creativity control from 1–9 for subtle refinement or bold reinterpretation. It accepts 1 input image and produces 1 enhanced output, with optional Face Recovery, Color Preservation, and grain settings for fine-tuned results. Ideal for improving AI artwork and illustrations, adding realism to CG renders, and refining facial detail in generated portraits.

templates.name: api_wavespeed_image_upscale
templates.title: Image Upscale: WaveSpeed
templates.description: Upload an image to upscale its resolution. Generate an enhanced 2K, 4K, or 8K output that preserves details and reduces artifacts in JPEG, PNG, or WEBP format.

templates.name: api_wavespeed_seedvr2_ai_image_fix
templates.title: Image Upscale: WaveSpeed SeedVR2
templates.description: Upload an AI-generated image to restore details and upscale. The workflow preserves colors and sharpness while minimizing artifacts. Output is a high-quality, enlarged version of your input.

templates.name: utility_nanobanana_pro_product_upscale
templates.title: Image Upscale: Nano Banana Pro Product
templates.description: Upload a product image to enhance its detail and sharpness. Generate an upscaled, high-quality output with improved typography and realistic coherence using the Nano Banana Pro model.

templates.name: utility_nanobanana_pro_illustration_upscale
templates.title: Image Upscale: Nano Banana Pro Illustration
templates.description: Upload a stylized art or illustration. Generate a creatively upscaled 4K image with enhanced detail using the Nano Banana Pro model, ideal for marketing or gaming assets.

templates.name: image_marigold_v2_surface_normal_estimation
templates.title: Surface Normal Estimation: Marigold V2
templates.description: Estimate surface normals from an input image using Marigold V2. The workflow generates a normal map representing the orientation of surfaces in the scene, useful for 3D reconstruction, relighting, and geometry-aware image processing.

templates.name: image_marigold_v2_albedo_estimation
templates.title: Albedo Estimation: Marigold V2
templates.description: Estimate albedo from an input image using Marigold V2. The workflow separates surface color from lighting and shading, producing an albedo map useful for relighting, material analysis, and 3D asset creation.

templates.name: utility_sdpose_ood_image_to_pose
templates.title: Pose Map: SDPose-OOD
templates.description: Upload an image to extract pose keypoints and generate a corresponding pose map using the SDPose-OOD model.

templates.name: api_bfl_flux1_expand_image

templates.name: utility_hitpaw_general_image_enhance
templates.title: Image Upscale: HitPaw Portrait
templates.description: Upload a low-quality portrait image and adjust the upscaling factor. Generate a high-fidelity, detailed portrait with enhanced skin textures and facial features.

templates.name: api_beeble_switchx_image_edit

templates.name: api_topaz_image_enhance
templates.title: Image Upscale: Topaz Reimagine
templates.description: Professional image enhancement using Topaz's Reimagine model with face enhancement and detail restoration.

templates.name: utility-topaz_landscape_upscaler
templates.title: Image Upscale: Topaz Reimagine Landscape
templates.description: Upload a landscape image to upscale and enhance details. Generate a high-resolution output optimized for natural scenery using Topaz Reimagine.

templates.name: api_bria_eraser

templates.description: Remove unwanted objects or regions from images with Bria's Eraser, which fills the masked area with surrounding context while leaving the rest of the image pixel-perfect. templates.name: template_sirolim_any_aspect_ratio_nb2

templates.name: utility_interpolation_image_upscale

templates.name: utility_sirolim_image_controlled_upscale

templates.name: utility_recraft_creative_image_upscale

templates.name: utility_recraft_crisp_image_upscale

templates.name: image_qwen_image_layered_control

templates.name: utility_pid_latent_upscale_dit

templates.name: video_minimax_h3_i2v

templates.description: Turn a starting image into a short, high-quality video clip with MiniMax H3, a unified multimodal model that generates visuals and synchronized audio in a single pass. templates.name: video_minimax_h3_r2v
templates.title: MiniMax H3: Reference to Video
templates.description: Generate a new video by feeding MiniMax H3 a reference image, up to nine images, three videos, and three audio clips alongside a text prompt, letting the model match character identity, motion, camera, voice, or style from those sources while producing native stereo audio in a single pass. Output is a single MP4 video at up to 2K resolution and 24fps for roughly 15 seconds. Ideal for character-consistent animation, style-transfer video generation, and audio-synced content creation.

templates.name: video_minimax_h3_t2v
templates.title: MiniMax H3: Text to Video
templates.description: Generate video with native stereo audio directly from a text prompt using MiniMax H3, an omni-modal model that synthesizes voice, sound effects, and music in a single pass. Output is up to 2K resolution, 24fps, and roughly 15 seconds long, with no file inputs required — just a prompt to one video output. Ideal for rapid concept visualization, social media content creation, and audio-synced storytelling.

templates.name: video_fasth3_ominiref_r2v
templates.title: FastH3 OmniRef: Reference to Video
templates.description: Generate synchronized video with matching audio from a text prompt plus a reference image using the FastH3 OmniRef eight-step distilled model, which renders both streams in just eight sampling steps. Takes 1 input image and produces 1 video output. Ideal for animating reference characters, creating talking avatars, and rapid social media video prototyping.

templates.name: video_ltx2_3_i2v
templates.title: LTX-2.3: Image to Video
templates.description: Upload an image to generate a video with improved motion consistency and fine details, including enhanced support for portrait formats and audio quality.

templates.name: video_wan2_2_14B_i2v

templates.description: Transform static images into dynamic videos with precise motion control and style preservation using Wan 2.2.

templates.name: video_ltx2_5_i2v
templates.title: LTX-2.5: Image to Video
templates.description: Generate video from a single image using LTX-2.5, producing a high-fidelity clip with industry-leading pixel quality and native multishot capability that holds character, environment, and lighting across connected scenes. Ideal for cinematic production, VFX shot creation, and content pipelines requiring fast, locally deployable video generation.

templates.name: video_ltx2_5_t2v
templates.title: LTX-2.5: Text to Video
templates.description: Generate cinematic video from a text prompt using LTX-2.5, a production-ready diffusion model that outputs a single video file with optional spatial upscaling for enhanced resolution. Ideal for film previsualization, commercial storyboards, and high-volume content creation pipelines.

templates.name: video_ltx2_5_dfr_i2v
templates.title: LTX-2.5 DFR: Image to Video
templates.description: Generate a short video with sound from a single image using LTX-2.5's DFR (Diffusion Fidelity Rendering) path: a half-resolution pass that carries generated detailing keyframes, a spatial x2 detailing pass with the pixel-spatial IC-LoRA, and an optional temporal x2 pass. Suited to cinematic shots, character beats and talking-image clips that need motion and synchronized audio.

templates.name: video_fastvideo_fasth3_i2v
templates.title: FastVideo FastH3: Image to Video
templates.description: Generate video with synchronized native audio from a single still image using MiniMax H3 and the FastH3 8-step checkpoint. One image produces one video output with matching voice, sound effects, and music in a single pass. Ideal for animating portraits, bringing product shots to life, and quick social media clips.

templates.name: video_fastvideo_fasth3_t2v
templates.title: FastVideo FastH3: Text to Video
templates.description: Generate synchronized video and audio directly from text using a distilled eight-step model, producing one video output with no file inputs required. Ideal for rapid text-to-video prototyping, audio-visual content creation, and creative storytelling where fast generation matters more than maximum detail.

templates.name: api_seedance2_5_i2v_1080p

templates.name: api_seedance2_5_r2v
templates.title: Seedance 2.5: Reference to Video
templates.description: Generate reference-driven videos with Seedance 2.5 by supplying up to 20 images, 6 video clips, and 6 audio clips to control character consistency, visual style, and motion rhythm in a single 4–30 second output with synchronized sound and lip-synced dialogue. Ideal for e-commerce product showcases, brand advertising, and character-driven short series.

templates.name: video_ltx2_3_ia2v
templates.title: LTX-2.3: Image Audio to Video
templates.description: Upload an image and an audio file to generate a high-quality video with synchronized lip movements using LTX-2.3.

templates.name: api_flux3_max_i2v
templates.title: FLUX 3 Max: Image to Video

templates.name: api_flux3_max_t2v

Outputs one clip of 5 to 20 seconds at 720p or 1080p, at any aspect ratio from 9:16 to 21:9, with ambient sound, speech, and effects created alongside the picture and no input files required. Ideal for cinematic concept clips, ad mockups, and social videos that need matching sound design.

templates.name: video_ltx2_3_t2v

templates.description: Generate a video from a text prompt, optionally using an image for reference. Receive a high-quality video with improved motion, audio, and detail, optimized for portrait or landscape formats.

Ideal for e-commerce background replacement, stylized remakes of footage, and ad re-editing with targeted retouching.

templates.name: api_seedance2_5_t2v

templates.name: api_seedance2_0_r2v

templates.name: api_mirelo_text_to_sfx

templates.description: Generate sound effects from a text prompt with Mirelo sfx-2.0: name the sound, its material, space and intensity in one line and get a 48 kHz mono audio file, up to 10 minutes.

templates.name: api_veed_clean_audio
templates.title: VEED Clean Audio: Speech Cleanup
templates.description: Remove background noise from a speech recording with VEED Clean Audio: music and effects go with the noise, pauses are cleaned completely, and the voice comes back as 48 kHz mono audio, optionally normalized to a target loudness. Audio up to 1799 seconds.

templates.name: api_elevenlabs_v4_text_to_speech
templates.title: Eleven v4: Text to Speech
templates.description: Generate expressive speech from text with Eleven v4, the quality-focused ElevenLabs model. Direct the performance with audio tags such as [whispers] or [excited] written into the script, or upload a voice sample to clone a voice and narrate the script in it. One audio file is output. Ideal for audiobooks, narration, and character voiceovers.

templates.name: api_elevenlabs_v4_text_to_dialogue

templates.description: Generate a multi-speaker dialogue from text with Eleven v4: give every entry its own line and its own voice, direct the delivery with audio tags such as [quietly] or [laughs], or clone a voice from a sample and let it take a turn. One audio file is output. Ideal for podcasts, game dialogue, and character conversations.

templates.name: audio_minimax_music_3

Ideal for music producers prototyping demos, and content creators needing original background tracks.

templates.name: api_bytedance_seed_audio1_0_t2a

templates.name: audio_yue2_music_cover

templates.description: Generate complete songs from a music style and lyrics with YuE2. Use symbolic music planning to create structured melodies and harmonies, then turn them into full songs with vocals and instrumental accompaniment.

templates.name: api_bytedance_seed_audio1_0_ta2a
templates.title: Seed Audio 1.0: Text + Audio to Audio
templates.description: Upload a reference audio clip and write a text prompt to clone the voice into a new scene. Generate dialogue, background music, and sound effects with up to 3 reference voices.

templates.name: api_bytedance_seed_audio1_0_ti2a

templates.name: audio_stable_audio_3_medium_base

templates.name: audio_stable_audio_3_medium

templates.name: api_fishaudio_text_to_speech
templates.title: Fish Audio: Text to Speech
templates.description: Generate natural, expressive speech from text with Fish Audio S2 Pro, a text-to-speech model supporting 80+ languages and fine-grained control over emotion, tone, and pacing using inline tags like [whisper] or [excited]. Input your text and receive one high-quality audio output, with optional style tags woven directly into the script. Ideal for voiceover production, multilingual content creation, and character dialogue in games or animations.

templates.name: api_fishaudio_voice_clone_tts
templates.title: Fish Audio: Voice Clone to Speech
templates.description: Clone any voice from a short recording, then use it to speak any script with Fish Audio. Record 2-3 clips of 15-20 seconds, connect them to the Instant Voice Clone node, and the cloned voice feeds straight into text to speech with no training wait. Add emotion tags to control how your cloned voice delivers each line. Great for personalized narration, character voices, and content in your own voice.

templates.name: api_fishaudio_speech_to_text
templates.title: Fish Audio: Speech to Text
templates.description: Transcribe audio to text with Fish Audio ASR. Language is detected automatically across 80+ languages, with optional word-level timestamps returned as JSON segments. Use it to create subtitles, transcribe recordings, or generate text prompts from audio clips. A sample audio is pre-loaded so you can test it right away.

templates.name: api_fishaudio_drama3_dialogue

templates.description: Generate a multi-speaker scene in one pass with Fish Audio Drama 3: connect one Voice Selector per speaker, mark speaker changes with @Voice1 / @Voice2, and direct the delivery with plain-language [directions] and <whisper> word tags.

templates.name: api_fishaudio_drama3_directed

templates.description: Direct a single Fish Audio Drama 3 performance from the text: shift the delivery mid-line with [plain-language directions] and wrap words with <whisper>...</whisper> tags.

templates.name: api_heygen_text_to_speech
templates.title: HeyGen: Text to Speech
templates.description: Generate natural-sounding speech from text using HeyGen's advanced TTS engine, supporting a wide range of languages and accents with customizable voices. Input your text and select from numerous preset voices or clone a custom voice from a short audio sample. Ideal for creating voiceovers for videos, generating multilingual narration, and producing personalized audio content.

templates.name: api_heygen_voice_1

templates.description: Clone a voice from a short recording with HeyGen Voice 1.0, then speak any script in that voice. Connect one audio clip to Instant Clone and the resulting voice_id feeds straight into text to speech, with no training wait. Use the expressiveness control to stay close to the recording or push more emotion into the delivery. Ideal for narration in your own voice, character dialogue, and multilingual voiceover.

templates.name: api_heygen_voice_1_turbo

It is the same instant clone as Voice 1.0, run through the turbo model, which renders faster for quick drafts and iteration. Connect one audio clip to Instant Clone and the resulting voice_id feeds straight into text to speech, while SaveText keeps the ID on disk for the next session. Ideal for narration in your own voice, character dialogue, and multilingual voiceover.

Includes background removal and a complete mesh post-processing pipeline: remesh, decimate, UV unwrap, and texture baking.

templates.name: utility_sam3d_body

The workflow loads one video and one text prompt, then outputs a reconstructed video showing the recovered human rig. templates.name: api_tripo_p2_image_to_model

It takes 1 input image, with optional multi-view references for better side and back accuracy. Ideal for game characters and props, hard-surface mechanical assets, and high-volume real-time pipelines.

templates.name: api_tripo_p2_text_to_model

templates.description: Generate production-ready 3D meshes from text prompts with Tripo P2, featuring native quad topology and mesh budgets up to 50,000 triangles or 25,000 quads. Ideal for game characters and props, hard-surface assets, and high-volume pipelines needing clean, rig-ready geometry.

templates.name: api_tripo_p2_multiview_to_model

templates.name: api_meshy7_1_text_to_model

templates.description: Generate detailed 3D models from text prompts using Meshy 7.1, with an optional Ultra 4K geometry mode that captures fine surface detail like stitching, wood grain, and scales as real geometry. Ideal for game asset creation, product visualization, and 3D printing preparation.

templates.name: api_meshy7_1_image_to_model

templates.description: Generate a 3D model from a single image using Meshy 7.1's Ultra 4K geometry mode, which produces 4096³ meshes so fine surface detail like stitching, wood grain, and scales becomes real geometry rather than texture. Takes one input image. Ideal for high-fidelity asset creation, detailed prop modeling, and product visualization.

templates.name: api_meshy_t2_5_smart_topology_t2m

templates.description: Generate a game-ready 3D model from a text prompt with Meshy T2.5. Meshy T2.5 builds the mesh at the triangle budget you set instead of generating a dense mesh and retopologizing it afterwards, so the result drops straight into a game engine. No input files required. Ideal for props, environment dressing and low-poly game assets that need a predictable triangle count.

templates.name: api_meshy_t2_5_smart_topology_i2m

Texturing with PBR maps is optional and runs at 2k, 4k or 8k. Ideal for turning concept art, product photos and sculpts into engine-ready props.

templates.name: api_patina_material_t2m
templates.title: Patina: Text to Material
templates.description: Generate a complete, seamlessly tiling PBR material from a text prompt with Patina. One run returns a base texture plus basecolor, normal, roughness, metalness and height maps that line up pixel for pixel, so the whole set drops straight into a 3D material. Works best on structured surfaces such as wood, stone, metal, fabric and ceramic tile; connect an image, optionally with a mask, to repaint an existing surface instead of inventing one.

templates.name: api_patina_material_i2m
templates.title: Patina: Image to Material
templates.description: Turn a photo of a surface into a seamless, tiling PBR material with Patina. The source image sets the pattern and Patina redraws it as a tileable material, returning basecolor, normal, roughness, metalness and height maps that line up pixel for pixel. Built for brick, stone, wood, plaster, fabric and ceramic tile; a mask can restrict the redraw to part of the image.

templates.name: api_patina_pbr_maps
templates.title: Patina: PBR Maps
templates.description: Turn one image into a set of PBR maps with Patina: basecolor, normal, roughness, metalness and height, all derived from exactly what the picture contains. No regeneration and no tiling - feed a flat, evenly lit surface photo or an existing basecolor map, pick the maps you need and drop them straight into a 3D material.

templates.name: api_patina_material_extract
templates.title: Patina: Material Extract
templates.description: Pull a seamless, tiling PBR material out of a photo of a surface with Patina. The prompt says which surface to extract and which structure to keep, and the base texture comes back with basecolor, normal, roughness, metalness and height maps aligned pixel for pixel. Made for photos that already contain the material you want: brick walls, paving, plaster, fabric.
