metadata.title: HY 3D 2.0 MV
metadata.description: Generate 3D models from multiple views using Hunyuan3D 2.0 MV.

metadata.name: 3d_hunyuan3d_multiview_to_model_turbo
metadata.title: HY 3D 2.0 MV Turbo
metadata.description: Generate 3D models from multiple views using Hunyuan3D 2.0 MV Turbo.

metadata.name: 3d_moge_panorama_to_mesh
metadata.title: MoGe: Panorama to Mesh
metadata.description: Upload an equirectangular 360° panorama image and generate a textured GLB mesh with vertex colors.

metadata.name: 3d_moge_perspective_to_mesh
metadata.title: MoGe: Perspective Geometry Estimation
metadata.description: Upload an image to estimate its perspective geometry. Generate a 3D depth map and surface normals from the input.

metadata.name: 3d_pixal3d_multi_views
metadata.title: Pixal3D: Multi Views to 3D
metadata.description: Upload your own separate view images, or use one mixed multi-view turnaround sheet. The workflow prepares front, back, left and right views, then reconstructs a textured 3D model with Pixal3D Multi-View.

metadata.name: 3d_pixal3d_trellis2_image_to_model
metadata.title: Pixal3D & TRELLIS.2: Image to Model
metadata.description: Upload a single image. Generate a high-fidelity 3D model with PBR textures using either Pixal3D or TRELLIS.2, toggled by a single switch. Both pipelines share the same DINOv3 encoder and shape/texture VAEs; Pixal3D adds MoGe camera estimation for pixel-aligned geometry. Includes background removal and a complete mesh post-processing pipeline: remesh, decimate, UV unwrap, and texture baking.

metadata.name: 3d_triposplat_image_to_gaussian_splat
metadata.title: TripoSplat: Image to Gaussian Splat
metadata.description: Upload a single 2D image. Generate a high-quality 3D Gaussian splat representation with controllable density and budget for rendering.

metadata.name: Image_capybara_v0_1_image_edit
metadata.title: Capybara: Image Edit
metadata.description: Upload an image or video and input a text instruction. Generate an edited output using the Capybara model for tasks like style changes, object replacement, or time-of-day adjustments.

metadata.name: Image_capybara_v0_1_text_to_image
metadata.title: Capybara: Text to Image
metadata.description: Input a text prompt to generate an image. This workflow uses the Capybara unified model for text-to-image synthesis.

metadata.name: api_anthropic_claude
metadata.title: Anthropic Claude
metadata.description: Input your query or image for analysis. Generate a natural language response powered by Anthropic Claude, supporting both text conversation and image understanding.

metadata.name: api_anthropic_claude_fable5
metadata.title: Claude: Fable 5
metadata.description: Claude Fable 5, Anthropic's first public Mythos-class frontier model, powers end-to-end creative workflows in ComfyUI. It takes 1 text prompt and generates 1 structured output including storyboard breakdowns, precise prompts for SD models and ControlNet, and custom node scripts. Ideal for concept artists refining visual narratives, AI filmmakers maintaining style consistency across series, and digital creators automating their entire rendering pipeline.

metadata.name: api_anthropic_claude_fable5_1
metadata.title: Claude: Fable 5.1
metadata.description: Run Claude Fable 5.1, Anthropic's frontier coding and agentic research model, directly in your workflow to tackle long-running, multi-step problems with state-of-the-art reasoning. This template provides access to the model's full capabilities, from root-cause software debugging and complex code generation to scientific analysis and knowledge work, with adjustable effort levels to balance cost and performance. Ideal for autonomous coding agents, deep technical investigations, and extended research tasks that require sustained, high-quality output.

metadata.name: api_anthropic_claude_opus_5
metadata.title: Claude: Opus 5
metadata.description: Load an image and enter a prompt to interact with Claude Opus 5, a highly capable and cost-efficient AI model that excels at coding, knowledge work, and problem-solving. Ideal for software engineering tasks, scientific research requiring visual analysis, and everyday productivity with a thoughtful, proactive assistant.

metadata.name: api_anthropic_claude_opus_5_5
metadata.title: Claude: Opus 5.5
metadata.description: This workflow pairs a single uploaded image with a text prompt, sending both to Claude Opus 5.5 for multimodal reasoning and response generation. Ideal for image captioning, visual question answering, and prompt-driven image analysis.

metadata.name: api_anthropic_claude_sonnet5
metadata.title: Claude: Sonnet 5
metadata.description: Leverage Claude Sonnet 5 for high-value autonomous task execution, bridging the gap to flagship performance at a lower cost. Input any text prompt or script to generate precise image descriptions, automated workflow scripts, shot sequence logs, or node logic corrections. Ideal for batch production tasks, debugging ComfyUI node logic, and maintaining consistent output quality across repetitive generation workflows.

metadata.name: api_beeble_switchx_image_edit
metadata.title: Relight: Beeble SwitchX
metadata.description: Upload your character image and a reference style/lighting image. Generate an edited output with the reference lighting and style applied to your original image.

metadata.name: api_beeble_switchx_video_edit
metadata.title: Video Edit: Beeble SwitchX
metadata.description: Upload a source video and a reference image, then provide a prompt describing the desired environment and lighting. Generate an edited video where masked regions follow your prompt and reference, while unmasked regions preserve the original pixels and motion, plus an alpha matte for compositing.

metadata.name: api_bfl_flux1_expand_image
metadata.title: Image Outpainting: Flux.1
metadata.description: Upload an image to expand its canvas using Flux.1. Generate an outpainted image with extended content.

metadata.name: api_bfl_flux2_max_sofa_swap
metadata.title: FLUX.2 [max]: Object Swap
metadata.description: Replace objects in images with unmatched quality using FLUX.2 [max]. Perfect for product photography, furniture swaps, and maintaining scene consistency with highest editing precision.

metadata.name: api_bfl_flux3_i2v
metadata.title: FLUX 3 Video: Image to Video
metadata.description: Generate full videos from a single text prompt using FLUX 3, which automatically expands your description into a cohesive scene with synchronized audio, motion, and physics. Outputs one 720p, 24fps MP4 video (5-20 seconds) with support for multi-shot structures and aspect ratios from 9:16 to 21:9. Ideal for product photography, filmic ad campaigns, and dynamic motion graphics.

metadata.name: api_bfl_flux3_image_bboxes
metadata.title: FLUX 3 Image: Bounding Box Edit
metadata.description: Place objects and text where you want them with FLUX 3 Image by feeding boxes from the Create Bounding Boxes node into the prompt, so each box carries its own description and copy into the render. Boxes are relative to the canvas, so set the output to the same aspect ratio. One image is output, up to 4K. Ideal for poster and layout composition, placing headlines and captions, and controlling where subjects sit in the frame.

metadata.name: api_bfl_flux3_image_edit
metadata.title: FLUX 3 Image: Image Edit
metadata.description: Edit or combine up to ten reference images from a text instruction with FLUX 3 Image, referring to them in the prompt as image 1, image 2, and so on. One image is output at any of sixteen aspect ratios and up to 4K, with web and image search grounding on by default. Ideal for character-consistent edits, product and object placement, and multi-reference scene compositing.

metadata.name: api_bfl_flux3_t2i
metadata.title: FLUX 3 Image: Text to Image
metadata.description: Generate an image from a text prompt with FLUX 3 Image, which interprets and expands the prompt before generating it, at any of sixteen aspect ratios and up to 4K. Web and image search grounding is on by default and no input files are required. One image is output. Ideal for typography-led posters, layout-driven design work, and fast exploration of visual concepts.

metadata.name: api_bfl_flux3_t2v
metadata.title: FLUX 3 Video: Text to Video
metadata.description: Generate full videos from a single text prompt with FLUX 3, which expands natural language into complete scenes with synchronized audio, no reference images or complex settings needed. Outputs 1 video in 720p at 24fps, 5 to 20 seconds long, supporting any aspect ratio from 9:16 to 21:9 with built-in sound design. Ideal for quick social media clips, ad mockups, and concept films requiring realistic motion and cinematic style.

metadata.name: api_bfl_flux_1_kontext_max_image
metadata.title: Flux.1 Kontext Max
metadata.description: Edit images with Flux.1 Kontext max image.

metadata.name: api_bfl_flux_1_kontext_multiple_images_input
metadata.title: Flux.1 Kontext Multiple Image Input
metadata.description: Input multiple images and edit them with Flux.1 Kontext.

metadata.name: api_bfl_flux_1_kontext_pro_image
metadata.title: Flux.1 Kontext Pro
metadata.description: Edit images with Flux.1 Kontext pro image.

metadata.name: api_bfl_flux_pro_t2i
metadata.title: Flux.1 [Pro]: Text to Image
metadata.description: Generate images with excellent prompt following and visual quality using FLUX.1 Pro.

metadata.name: api_bfl_flux_video_upscale
metadata.title: Video Upscale: FLUX 3
metadata.description: Upscale video clips to 1080p, 2K, or 4K using FLUX 3 super-resolution, with a precise mode that preserves source fidelity and a creative mode that enhances fine detail. It accepts 1 video input, up to 20 seconds long, and produces 1 upscaled mp4 output with an optional prompt to guide detail enhancement. Ideal for restoring low-resolution footage, preparing clips for large-screen delivery, and adding crispness to AI-generated video.

metadata.name: api_bria_eraser
metadata.title: Object Removal: Bria Eraser
metadata.description: Remove unwanted objects or regions from images with Bria's Eraser, which fills the masked area with surrounding context while leaving the rest of the image pixel-perfect. Upload 1 image, paint over the target object with a brush mask, and receive 1 cleaned output alongside a before-and-after comparison. Ideal for cleaning up photobombs, removing watermarks or text, and decluttering product or real-estate photos.

metadata.name: api_bria_expand_image
metadata.title: Image Outpainting: Bria
metadata.description: Expand an image beyond its original borders using Bria's outpainting API, generating new surrounding content that matches the original lighting, perspective, and texture while leaving the source untouched. Choose from preset aspect ratios, custom dimensions, or manual canvas placement, with optional text prompts to guide the expansion direction or an auto-generated prompt when left blank. Ideal for extending compositions for print layouts, creating panoramic versions of existing photos, and adapting artwork to new formats or social media dimensions.

metadata.name: api_bria_fibo2_t2i
metadata.title: Bria: FIBO 2.0 Text to Image
metadata.description: Generate an image from a text prompt with Bria FIBO 2.0, one model for both generation and editing. It is trained on structured VGL captions, so a detailed poster-style brief is followed closely, exact wording is rendered literally, and the node also returns that structured prompt so the same image can be rebuilt or refined from JSON. Ideal for editorial covers, posters and typography-led layouts.

metadata.name: api_bria_genfill
metadata.title: Inpainting: Bria Generative Fill
metadata.description: Use Bria's Generative Fill API to regenerate a specific region of an image while keeping everything outside the mask pixel-perfect unchanged. Paint a mask over the target area, write a detailed prompt for the replacement content, and compare the before/after side-by-side before exporting. Ideal for product photography corrections, object removal or replacement, and creative compositing where precise control over the edited region matters.

metadata.name: api_bria_guided_remove_background
metadata.title: Bria: Guided Background Removal
metadata.description: Remove the background from an image with Bria while keeping whatever a text prompt describes, so one subject can be cut out of a busy scene instead of losing everything that is not background. The original pixels come back at full resolution with a new alpha channel. Ideal for product cutouts, portrait isolation and compositing prep.

metadata.name: api_bria_image_edit
metadata.title: Bria: FIBO 2.0 Image Edit
metadata.description: Edit an image with Bria FIBO 2.0 by describing the change in plain language, with an optional mask to confine it to one region. FIBO 2.0 is one model for both editing and generation, trained on structured VGL captions, so it holds everything you did not ask to change, and it returns that structured prompt so the edit can be rebuilt or refined from JSON.

metadata.name: api_bria_image_outpainting
metadata.title: Bria: Image Outpainting
metadata.description: A professional Bria-powered outpainting template designed for seamless image extension and edge-aware scene expansion

metadata.name: api_bria_product_holding
metadata.title: Bria: Product Holding
metadata.description: Place a product into the hands of the person in a photo with Bria. One person photo plus one to three product shots is enough for a lifestyle image in which the face, pose and background stay untouched and the product is held naturally. Ideal for e-commerce and social content that would otherwise need a shoot.

metadata.name: api_bria_remove_video_background
metadata.title: Remove Background: Bria Solid Color
metadata.description: Upload a video to remove its background and replace it with your chosen color. Generate a video with the subject isolated and a new solid background.

metadata.name: api_bria_remove_video_background_transparent
metadata.title: Remove Background: Bria Transparent
metadata.description: Upload a video and generate its frames with a transparent background, outputting image and mask sequences along with a WebM video supporting an alpha channel.

metadata.name: api_bria_video_green_screen
metadata.title: Green Screen: Bria
metadata.description: Upload a video to generate a green screen version with a transparent or solid background.

metadata.name: api_bria_video_replace_background
metadata.title: Replace Background: Bria
metadata.description: Upload a video and a background image. Detect the main subject and replace the original background with the provided image. Ideal for content creation, virtual production, and background cleanup in video projects.

metadata.name: api_bria_virtual_try_on
metadata.title: Bria: Virtual Try-On
metadata.description: Dress the person in a photo with a garment from a separate product shot using Bria. One person photo plus one to three garments or accessories produces a worn look in which the face, pose and background stay untouched and the garment is refitted to the body. Ideal for fashion catalogs and lookbooks without a photoshoot.

metadata.name: api_bytedance_flf2v
metadata.title: Seedance1.0 Pro: Start End to Video
metadata.description: Generate cinematic video transitions between start and end frames with fluid motion, scene consistency, and professional polish using ByteDance's Seedance model.

metadata.name: api_bytedance_image_to_video
metadata.title: Seedance 1.0 Pro: Image to Video
metadata.description: Transform static images into dynamic videos using ByteDance's Seedance model. Analyzes image structure and generates natural motion with consistent visual style and coherent video sequences.

metadata.name: api_bytedance_seed
metadata.title: ByteDance: Seed 2.0
metadata.description: Input an image or video for analysis. Receive detailed text output describing visual content, reasoning, and structured information extraction.

metadata.name: api_bytedance_seed_audio1_0_t2a
metadata.title: Seed Audio 1.0: Text to Audio
metadata.description: Input a text prompt to generate speech, dialogue, background music, and sound effects in one audio file. Describe voices, emotion, and scene details to create multi-speaker audio up to 2 minutes.

metadata.name: api_bytedance_seed_audio1_0_ta2a
metadata.title: Seed Audio 1.0: Text + Audio to Audio
metadata.description: Upload a reference audio clip and write a text prompt to clone the voice into a new scene. Generate dialogue, background music, and sound effects with up to 3 reference voices.

metadata.name: api_bytedance_seed_audio1_0_ti2a
metadata.title: Seed Audio 1.0: Text + Image to Audio
metadata.description: Upload a character image and write a text prompt to generate audio. The model derives the voice from your image, then produces speech, ambience, background music, and sound effects.

metadata.name: api_bytedance_seedance1_5_flf2v
metadata.title: Seedance 1.5 Pro: FLF2V
metadata.description: Upload a start frame and end frame, and Seedance 1.5 Pro automatically generates a smooth video transition with synchronized audio between them.

metadata.name: api_bytedance_seedance1_5_image_to_video
metadata.title: Seedance 1.5 Pro: Image to Video
metadata.description: Transform images into living characters with speech, motion, and synchronized sound effects.

metadata.name: api_bytedance_seedance1_5_text_to_video
metadata.title: Seedance1.5 Pro: Text to Video
metadata.description: Create complete audio-visual stories from text with synchronized voices, music, and sound effects.

metadata.name: api_bytedance_seedream4
metadata.title: Seedream 4.0: Image Edit
metadata.description: Multi-modal AI model for text-to-image and image editing. Generate 2K images in under 2 seconds with natural language control.

metadata.name: api_bytedance_seedream_5_0_flash_image_edit
metadata.title: Seedream 5.0 Flash: Image Edit
metadata.description: Edit and generate images with Seedream 5.0 Flash, transforming a single input image into one refined output with cinematic lighting, accurate text rendering, and resolutions up to 2K.

metadata.name: api_bytedance_seedream_5_0_flash_t2i
metadata.title: Seedream 5.0 Flash: Text to Image
metadata.description: Generate high-quality images from text prompts using Seedream 5.0 Flash, producing detailed 1K, 1.5K, or 2K visuals with cinematic lighting and accurate text rendering, saved as a single image output.

metadata.name: api_bytedance_seedream_5_0_layer_separation
metadata.title: Layer Decomposition: Seedream 5.0 Pro
metadata.description: Split any image into independent, editable layers — subject, product, background, and text — with a single text instruction using Seedream 5.0 Pro. A single poster can yield 10+ layers, with design-grade text separation supporting multilingual headlines and CJK fonts. Ideal for brand design, e-commerce asset creation, and layout iteration.

metadata.name: api_bytedance_seedream_5_0_lite_image_edit
metadata.title: Seedream 5.0 Lite: Image Edit
metadata.description: Upload an image and a text prompt to edit it. Generate a modified image where the details align with your instructions.

metadata.name: api_bytedance_seedream_5_0_lite_t2i
metadata.title: Seedream 5.0 Lite: Text to Image
metadata.description: Input your text prompt to generate a detailed image. This workflow creates a visual representation of your description with precise control over style and layout.

metadata.name: api_bytedance_seedream_5_0_pro_image_edit
metadata.title: Seedream 5.0 Pro: Image Edit
metadata.description: Edit images with precision using Seedream 5.0 Pro, targeting specific regions while preserving lighting, depth, and texture. The workflow takes 1 input image and produces 1 output image. Ideal for product photography edits, portrait consistency adjustments, and creating structured layouts with multilingual text.

metadata.name: api_bytedance_seedream_5_0_pro_t2i
metadata.title: Seedream 5.0 Pro: Text to Image
metadata.description: Generate images from text prompts using Seedream 5.0 Pro, producing one high-quality output. Ideal for creative concept art, marketing visual mockups, and rapid ideation for design projects.

metadata.name: api_bytedance_text_to_video
metadata.title: Seedance1.0 Pro: Text to Video
metadata.description: Generate high-quality videos directly from text prompts using ByteDance's Seedance model. Supports multiple resolutions and aspect ratios with natural motion and cinematic quality.

metadata.name: api_bytedance_vcube_video_enhance
metadata.title: Video Upscale: ByteDance vCube
metadata.description: Enhance video quality with ByteDance vCube, an AI-driven tool that upscales and restores footage through shot-adaptive processing, fixing compression artifacts and color distortion while preserving original texture. Ideal for improving UGC clips, refining AIGC content, and restoring classic films with vibrant, clear results.

metadata.name: api_clarity_ai_crystal_upscale
metadata.title: Clarity AI: Crystal Upscaler
metadata.description: Upscale and enhance images with the precision-focused Crystal model, preserving real detail while adding resolution. Takes one image in and returns one upscaled image plus a side-by-side comparison view. Ideal for portraits, product shots, and print-ready enlargements where faithful detail matters.

metadata.name: api_clarity_ai_crystal_video_upscale
metadata.title: Clarity AI: Crystal Video Upscaler
metadata.description: Upscale a video with Clarity AI's Crystal model, running through the Fal proxy: one video in, one upscaled video out. Set scale_factor to multiply the frame size, and the output keeps the source resolution, frame count and audio track. The result is capped at 9 megapixels per frame and 360 megapixel-seconds per clip, so long or oversized clips come back upscaled by less than the factor you asked for. Ideal for restoring generated clips, preparing footage for large screens, and sharpening soft AI video.

metadata.name: api_elevenLabs_speech_to_text
metadata.title: ElevenLabs: Speech to text
metadata.description: Upload an audio or video file to transcribe its speech into accurate, editable text.

metadata.name: api_elevenlabs_speech_to_speech
metadata.title: ElevenLabs: Speech to Speech
metadata.description: Upload a source audio file to apply a new voice tone or clone a different voice, generating a modified audio output.

metadata.name: api_elevenlabs_text_to_dialogue
metadata.title: ElevenLabs: Text to Dialogue
metadata.description: Input text and select a voice profile to generate a high-quality, emotionally expressive audio dialogue.

metadata.name: api_elevenlabs_text_to_sound_effects
metadata.title: ElevenLabs: Text to Sound Effects
metadata.description: Input a text prompt to generate custom sound effects and ambient audio.

metadata.name: api_elevenlabs_text_to_speech
metadata.title: ElevenLabs: Text to Speech
metadata.description: Input text to generate speech with ultra-realistic voices, or upload a voice sample to clone it for synthesis.

metadata.name: api_elevenlabs_v4_text_to_dialogue
metadata.title: Eleven v4: Text to Dialogue
metadata.description: Generate a multi-speaker dialogue from text with Eleven v4: give every entry its own line and its own voice, direct the delivery with audio tags such as [quietly] or [laughs], or clone a voice from a sample and let it take a turn. One audio file is output. Ideal for podcasts, game dialogue, and character conversations.

metadata.name: api_elevenlabs_v4_text_to_speech
metadata.title: Eleven v4: Text to Speech
metadata.description: Generate expressive speech from text with Eleven v4, the quality-focused ElevenLabs model. Direct the performance with audio tags such as [whispers] or [excited] written into the script, or upload a voice sample to clone a voice and narrate the script in it. One audio file is output. Ideal for audiobooks, narration, and character voiceovers.

metadata.name: api_elevenlabs_voice_isolation
metadata.title: ElevenLabs: Voice Isolation
metadata.description: Upload an audio file containing background noise. Use the ElevenLabs API to isolate and output a clean voice track.

metadata.name: api_fishaudio_drama3_dialogue
metadata.title: Fish Audio Drama 3: Two-Speaker Dialogue
metadata.description: Generate a multi-speaker scene in one pass with Fish Audio Drama 3: connect one Voice Selector per speaker, mark speaker changes with @Voice1 / @Voice2, and direct the delivery with plain-language [directions] and <whisper> word tags.

metadata.name: api_fishaudio_drama3_directed
metadata.title: Fish Audio Drama 3: Directed Performance
metadata.description: Direct a single Fish Audio Drama 3 performance from the text: shift the delivery mid-line with [plain-language directions] and wrap words with <whisper>...</whisper> tags.

metadata.name: api_fishaudio_speech_to_text
metadata.title: Fish Audio: Speech to Text
metadata.description: Transcribe audio to text with Fish Audio ASR. Language is detected automatically across 80+ languages, with optional word-level timestamps returned as JSON segments. Use it to create subtitles, transcribe recordings, or generate text prompts from audio clips. A sample audio is pre-loaded so you can test it right away.

metadata.name: api_fishaudio_text_to_speech
metadata.title: Fish Audio: Text to Speech
metadata.description: Generate natural, expressive speech from text with Fish Audio S2 Pro, a text-to-speech model supporting 80+ languages and fine-grained control over emotion, tone, and pacing using inline tags like [whisper] or [excited]. Input your text and receive one high-quality audio output, with optional style tags woven directly into the script. Ideal for voiceover production, multilingual content creation, and character dialogue in games or animations.

metadata.name: api_fishaudio_voice_clone_tts
metadata.title: Fish Audio: Voice Clone to Speech
metadata.description: Clone any voice from a short recording, then use it to speak any script with Fish Audio. Record 2-3 clips of 15-20 seconds, connect them to the Instant Voice Clone node, and the cloned voice feeds straight into text to speech with no training wait. Add emotion tags to control how your cloned voice delivers each line. Great for personalized narration, character voices, and content in your own voice.

metadata.name: api_flux2
metadata.title: FLUX.2 Pro
metadata.description: Generate up to 4MP photorealistic images with multi-reference consistency and professional text rendering.

metadata.name: api_flux3_max_i2v
metadata.title: FLUX 3 Max: Image to Video
metadata.description: Animate a single still image into a short video clip using FLUX 3 Max, taking one input image and producing one video output. Ideal for bringing product shots, portraits, and concept art to life, generating social media motion content, and rapid prototyping of animated scenes.

metadata.name: api_flux3_max_t2v
metadata.title: FLUX 3 Max: Text to Video
metadata.description: Generate a video with synchronized audio from a single text prompt with FLUX 3 Max, which reasons about and expands the prompt before rendering. Outputs one clip of 5 to 20 seconds at 720p or 1080p, at any aspect ratio from 9:16 to 21:9, with ambient sound, speech, and effects created alongside the picture and no input files required. Ideal for cinematic concept clips, ad mockups, and social videos that need matching sound design.

metadata.name: api_flux_erase_image
metadata.title: Object Removal: Flux
metadata.description: Upload an image and paint a mask over the object to remove. The workflow erases the masked area and reconstructs the background.

metadata.name: api_flux_video_edit
metadata.title: Flux Video Edit
metadata.description: Edit and transform images with FLUX using simple text prompts. Change characters, objects, backgrounds, styles, or entire scenes while preserving the key details and overall consistency of the original image.

metadata.name: api_flux_vto
metadata.title: Virtual Try-On: Flux
metadata.description: Upload a person photo and a garment image. Generate a virtual try-on result with the garment applied to the person while preserving face and pose.

metadata.name: api_from_photo_2_miniature
metadata.title: Photo to Blueprint to Model
metadata.description: Transform real building photos into architectural blueprints and then into detailed physical scale models. A complete architectural visualization pipeline from photo to miniature.

metadata.name: api_google_gemini
metadata.title: Google Gemini
metadata.description: Experience Google's multimodal AI with Gemini's reasoning capabilities.

metadata.name: api_google_gemini_image
metadata.title: Nano Banana
metadata.description: Nano-banana (Gemini-2.5-Flash Image) - image editing with consistency.

metadata.name: api_google_gemini_omni_flash_1_1_edit
metadata.title: Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash: Video Edit
metadata.description: Edit videos through natural language conversation with Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash. Upload a clip (10 seconds or less) and describe the change: swap backgrounds, restyle scenes, add or remove elements, and the model applies the edit while preserving everything you did not mention. Add \"Keep everything else the same\" for maximum consistency; simple prompts work best. Outputs video with native audio at 16:9 or 9:16, with 1080p/4K output available. Ideal for remixes, style changes, and iterative refinement without re-generating from scratch.

metadata.name: api_google_gemini_omni_flash_1_1_extend
metadata.title: Video Extend: Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash
metadata.description: Extend an existing video by up to 10 seconds per step, building stories up to 40 seconds total with Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash. The model analyzes the last 10 seconds of context, keeping characters, motion, and audio coherent as the scene continues from where it left off. Optionally attach reference images to introduce new characters mid-story. Works on uploaded clips and previously generated videos; describe how the scene should continue in plain language. Ideal for longer narratives, scene branching, and iterative storytelling.

metadata.name: api_google_gemini_omni_flash_1_1_i2v
metadata.title: Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash: Image to Video
metadata.description: Generate videos from text prompts or reference images using Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash, a multimodal model that handles text-to-video, image-to-video, keyframe interpolation, and iterative video editing with natural language. Outputs a single MP4 video with optional audio, supporting aspect ratios, resolutions up to 4K, and scene extension. Ideal for cinematic storytelling, product visualization, and rapid video prototyping.

metadata.name: api_google_gemini_omni_flash_1_1_r2v
metadata.title: Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash: Reference to Video
metadata.description: Generate video that incorporates specific subjects from multiple reference images using Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash's reference mode: characters, products, and objects from your images appear in the scene while the image itself is never shown as a frame. Bind each image to a role with tags like <IMAGE_REF_0>, combine character references with style references, and direct the scene in plain language with native audio. Ideal for character-driven stories, product placement, and brand-consistent content.

metadata.name: api_google_gemini_omni_flash_1_1_t2v
metadata.title: Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash: Text to Video
metadata.description: Generate cinematic videos with audio from text prompts or reference images using Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash, supporting aspect ratio, resolution, and keyframe interpolation controls. Ideal for text-to-video storytelling, animating product shots or illustrations, and iterative conversational video editing.

metadata.name: api_google_gemini_omni_flash_i2v
metadata.title: Gemini Omni Flash: Image to Video
metadata.description: Generate a video from two images using Gemini Omni Flash, which interprets natural language prompts to control duration and aspect ratio. The workflow accepts 2 input images and produces 1 video output. Ideal for creating short brand clips, dynamic social media content, and iterative video edits through conversational prompting.

metadata.name: api_google_gemini_omni_flash_t2v
metadata.title: Gemini Omni Flash: Text to Video
metadata.description: Generate cinematic video from natural language prompts using Gemini Omni Flash, transforming text descriptions into a single video output with world-aware motion, lighting, and sound. Ideal for social media content creation, rapid video prototyping, and iterative visual storytelling with conversational editing.

metadata.name: api_google_gemini_omni_flash_video_edit
metadata.title: Gemini Omni Flash: Video Edit
metadata.description: Edit videos with natural language using Gemini Omni Flash, transforming a single input video into one edited output based on your descriptive instructions. Specify the duration and aspect ratio in your prompt, and leverage Omni's world knowledge for intuitive edits like changing backgrounds or adding atmosphere. Ideal for quick social media remixes, cinematic scene adjustments, and iterative video refinements without technical prompts.

metadata.name: api_google_nano_banana2_image_edit
metadata.title: Nano Banana 2: Image Edit
metadata.description: Upload an image and a text prompt to edit it. Generate a new image that modifies the original based on your instructions, maintaining subject consistency and high visual fidelity.

metadata.name: api_google_nano_banana2_image_edit_continuation
metadata.title: Image Edit
metadata.description: Start with an image and an empty prompt, then describe the edit you want. Nano Banana 2 generates a modified image while preserving subject consistency and high visual fidelity.

metadata.name: api_google_nano_banana2_text_to_image
metadata.title: Nano Banana 2: Text to Image
metadata.description: Generate images from text prompts using the Nano Banana 2 model, producing one image output with no file inputs required. Ideal for rapid prototyping, concept art generation, and creative exploration.

metadata.name: api_google_nano_banana_create_turnaround_sheet
metadata.title: Character Turnaround Sheet Generator
metadata.description: Create orthographic multi-view character turnaround sheet from one reference image, keep consistent character features across front, side and back views, for sci-fi mech and armor character design.

metadata.name: api_grok_image_edit
metadata.title: Grok: Image Edit
metadata.description: Upload an image to edit with the Grok model. Generate a modified version with expressive, cinematic visuals

metadata.name: api_grok_imagine_image_2_image_edit
metadata.title: Grok Imagine Image 2.0: Image Edit
metadata.description: Grok Imagine Image 2.0 performs precise image editing and text rendering using xAI's Aurora engine, letting you modify specific elements, swap backgrounds, or restyle scenes through natural language with crisp short-text output. It takes up to 3 reference images and generates at 1K or 2K resolution across 14 aspect ratios, with strong character consistency across scenes. Ideal for poster and cover design, product and brand visuals, or multi-scene character workflows.

metadata.name: api_grok_imagine_image_2_t2i
metadata.title: Grok Imagine Image 2.0: Text to Image
metadata.description: Generate images from text prompts using Grok Imagine Image 2.0, an Aurora-engine model that excels at crisp short-text rendering and 1K or 2K outputs across 14 aspect ratios. Enter one text prompt and receive one generated image, with low or medium quality options to control cost. Ideal for poster and cover design, product and brand visuals, and character-driven scenes where consistency matters.

metadata.name: api_grok_imagine_image_quality_image_edit
metadata.title: Grok Imagine Image Quality: Edit
metadata.description: Enhance image quality with advanced text rendering and creative control using Grok Imagine Image Quality. Input images or prompts for improved detail and fidelity.

metadata.name: api_grok_imagine_image_quality_image_generation
metadata.title: Grok Imagine Image Quality: Generation
metadata.description: Generate enhanced images with improved details, text rendering, and creative control using the advanced quality mode in Grok Imagine.

metadata.name: api_grok_imagine_video_1_5
metadata.title: Grok Imagine Video 1.5: Image to Video
metadata.description: Upload an image and optional text prompt to generate a video with native audio, realistic motion, and high-quality output up to 720p resolution.

metadata.name: api_grok_imagine_video_1_5_lite_i2v
metadata.title: Grok Imagine Video 1.5 Lite: Image to Video
metadata.description: Generate short videos from a single still image using Grok Imagine Video 1.5 Lite, a faster, lower-cost model that turns one image into a video clip up to 15 seconds at resolutions up to 1080p. Ideal for rapid social content, storyboard previews, and high-volume creative iteration where speed and cost matter more than maximum fidelity.

metadata.name: api_grok_imagine_video_1_5_lite_t2v
metadata.title: Grok Imagine Video 1.5 Lite: Text to Video
metadata.description: Generate a video of up to 15 seconds from a text prompt with Grok Imagine Video 1.5 Lite, the distilled and faster version of Imagine Video 1.5, with native audio and 480p, 720p or 1080p output in any of seven aspect ratios. No input files are required and one video is output. Ideal for social clips, ad mockups, and fast iteration where a full-quality render is not worth the wait.

metadata.name: api_grok_reference_to_video
metadata.title: Grok: Reference to Video
metadata.description: Upload a reference image and generate a video using the Grok API, supporting up to 6 reference images for enhanced consistency.

metadata.name: api_grok_text_to_image
metadata.title: Grok: Text to Image
metadata.description: Input text prompts to generate high-quality images quickly using the Grok model.

metadata.name: api_grok_video
metadata.title: Grok: Video generation
metadata.description: Input text prompts or an initial image frame to generate up to 15-second videos with synchronized audio using the Grok model.

metadata.name: api_grok_video_edit
metadata.title: Grok: Video Edit
metadata.description: Upload a video to edit. Input your desired modifications. Generate an edited video using the Grok API.

metadata.name: api_grok_video_extend
metadata.title: Video Extend: Grok
metadata.description: Upload a short video and a text prompt describing the next scene. Generate a seamless video extension using Grok extend.

metadata.name: api_happyhorse1_0_i2v
metadata.title: HappyHorse: Image to Video
metadata.description: Generate high-quality, fluid videos from images using HappyHorse-1.0-I2V with realistic dynamic rendering and accurate text and image semantic comprehension.

metadata.name: api_happyhorse1_0_r2v
metadata.title: HappyHorse: Reference to Video
metadata.description: Generate videos that preserve subject characters from multiple reference images using text prompts. Input up to 9 reference images and a scene description to produce a 3-15 second video output.

metadata.name: api_happyhorse1_0_t2v
metadata.title: HappyHorse: Text to Video
metadata.description: Generate high-quality, realistic videos from text prompts with fluid motion and rich detail. Input text descriptions to produce dynamic videos with accurate semantic comprehension.

metadata.name: api_happyhorse1_0_video_edit
metadata.title: HappyHorse: Video Edit
metadata.description: Edit a video using text instructions and optional reference images for style transfer or local replacement. Takes a video and up to 5 reference images as input, outputs an edited video.

metadata.name: api_happyhorse1_1_i2v
metadata.title: HappyHorse 1.1: Image to Video
metadata.description: Animate a static first frame into a short video with synchronized audio using HappyHorse 1.1, taking 1 input image and producing 1 video output. Ideal for e-commerce product demos, brand marketing content, and short episodic series.

metadata.name: api_happyhorse1_1_r2v
metadata.title: HappyHorse 1.1: Reference to Video
metadata.description: Generate video from reference images using HappyHorse 1.1, locking character and scene appearance while following a text prompt for motion. This workflow takes 2 input images (character reference and scene reference) and produces 1 video output. Ideal for short films, advertising, and game cutscenes requiring consistent character design and controllable narrative.

metadata.name: api_happyhorse1_1_t2v
metadata.title: HappyHorse 1.1: Text to Video
metadata.description: Generate a video with synchronized audio from a text prompt using HappyHorse 1.1, producing a single video output with dialogue, sound effects, and music baked in. Ideal for short episodic series, e-commerce commercials, and game cutscenes.

metadata.name: api_heygen_avatar_video
metadata.title: HeyGen: Avatar Video
metadata.description: Create an AI avatar video from a text prompt or uploaded image using HeyGen's avatar generation technology, outputting a single talking-head video. You can save the avatar ID for reuse in future videos. Ideal for personalized digital presenters, social media content creation, and multilingual video production without recording talent.

metadata.name: api_heygen_talking_photo
metadata.title: HeyGen: Talking Photo
metadata.description: Generate a talking-head video from a single photograph using HeyGen's Avatar IV engine, which produces a fully animated video with lip-synced speech, facial expressions, head movements, and automatic gestures. Ideal for creating digital avatars for presentations, virtual characters for interactive content, and personalized video messages from a single image.

metadata.name: api_heygen_text_to_speech
metadata.title: HeyGen: Text to Speech
metadata.description: Generate natural-sounding speech from text using HeyGen's advanced TTS engine, supporting a wide range of languages and accents with customizable voices. Input your text and select from numerous preset voices or clone a custom voice from a short audio sample. Ideal for creating voiceovers for videos, generating multilingual narration, and producing personalized audio content.

metadata.name: api_heygen_video_1_i2v
metadata.title: HeyGen Video 1.0: Image to Video
metadata.description: Generate a 5-15 second clip with synchronized dialogue and sound from a single image using HeyGen Video 1.0, which starts on that exact frame and keeps the image's aspect ratio, at 480p or 768p. The prompt drives both the action and the spoken line, and one video is output. Ideal for giving a portrait or product photo a voice, producing talking-head clips without a shoot, and bringing stills to life.

metadata.name: api_heygen_video_1_r2v
metadata.title: HeyGen Video 1.0: Reference to Video
metadata.description: Generate a 5-15 second video with dialogue and sound from a prompt plus up to nine images, three videos and three audio clips using HeyGen Video 1.0, addressed in the prompt as @Image1, @Video1 and @Audio1. One video is output, with the people, products and places you supply driving the shot. Ideal for product demos, UGC-style clips that keep one presenter or product consistent, and placing your product into a scene of your own.

metadata.name: api_heygen_video_1_t2v
metadata.title: HeyGen Video 1.0: Text to Video
metadata.description: Generate a 5-15 second clip with synchronized dialogue and sound from a text prompt using HeyGen Video 1.0, at 480p or 768p in any of six aspect ratios, with no input files required. One video is output. Ideal for UGC-style talking clips, product explainers, and short social ads where the spoken line and the ambience have to match the scene.

metadata.name: api_heygen_video_translate
metadata.title: HeyGen: Video Translate
metadata.description: Translate video content into another language with full lip-sync using HeyGen Translate, which automatically transcribes speech, translates it, generates a cloned voice, and re-syncs mouth movements. Takes 1 input video and produces 1 output video. Ideal for localizing talking-head videos, dubbing multilingual presentations, and creating lip-synced content for global audiences.

metadata.name: api_heygen_voice_1
metadata.title: HeyGen Voice 1.0: Voice Clone to Speech
metadata.description: Clone a voice from a short recording with HeyGen Voice 1.0, then speak any script in that voice. Connect one audio clip to Instant Clone and the resulting voice_id feeds straight into text to speech, with no training wait. Use the expressiveness control to stay close to the recording or push more emotion into the delivery. Ideal for narration in your own voice, character dialogue, and multilingual voiceover.

metadata.name: api_heygen_voice_1_turbo
metadata.title: HeyGen Voice 1.0 Turbo: Voice Clone to Speech
metadata.description: Clone a voice from a short recording with HeyGen Voice 1.0 Turbo, then speak any script in that voice. It is the same instant clone as Voice 1.0, run through the turbo model, which renders faster for quick drafts and iteration. Connect one audio clip to Instant Clone and the resulting voice_id feeds straight into text to speech, while SaveText keeps the ID on disk for the next session. Ideal for narration in your own voice, character dialogue, and multilingual voiceover.

metadata.name: api_higgsfield_genjutsu_motion_transfer
metadata.title: Higgsfield Genjutsu: Motion Transfer
metadata.description: Recast an existing video with Higgsfield Genjutsu: the source clip keeps its motion, camera movement, timing and audio, while the cast, location and style are rebuilt from 1 to 8 reference images. Describe which reference replaces what in the optional prompt. Output length follows the source clip. Ideal for restyling footage, swapping the cast of a shot, and building scenes a shoot never covered.

metadata.name: api_hunyuan3d_image_to_model
metadata.title: HY 3D: Image to Model
metadata.description: Upload an image to generate a 3D model with geometry and PBR textures.

metadata.name: api_hunyuan3d_model2uv
metadata.title: HY 3D: UV Unwrapping
metadata.description: Upload a 3D model to perform UV unwrapping. Generate a processed model with optimized UV layout for texturing.

metadata.name: api_hunyuan3d_part
metadata.title: HY 3D: 3D Parts Decomposition
metadata.description: Upload a 3D model to automatically segment it into its constituent parts, generating a fully decomposed 3D asset for reuse and editing.

metadata.name: api_hunyuan3d_retopo_uv
metadata.title: Hunyuan3D: Model Retopology and UV Unwrapping
metadata.description: Input a dense mesh (from AI generation or photogrammetry scans) and create a lightweight model with good topology and unwrapped UV. Great for 3D game asset optimization.

metadata.name: api_hunyuan3d_smart_topology
metadata.title: HY 3D: Smart Topology
metadata.description: Upload a high-poly 3D model file. Generate a lower-polygon, topologically optimized 3D model with a specified reduction level.

metadata.name: api_hunyuan3d_text_to_model
metadata.title: Hunyuan3D: Text to Model
metadata.description: Input a text prompt or upload a reference image to generate a detailed 3D model asset.

metadata.name: api_ideogram_p_image_t2i
metadata.title: Ideogram P-Image: Text to Image
metadata.description: Generate images from text descriptions using Ideogram's fast P-Image model, which delivers quality comparable to leading image models at significantly lower cost and latency. One text prompt is accepted and one image is output, with controls for quality level and resolution. Ideal for rapid iteration in design workflows, high-volume content production, and cost-sensitive A/B testing of visual concepts.

metadata.name: api_ideogram_v4_5_image_edit
metadata.title: Ideogram 4.5: Image Edit
metadata.description: Generate edited or combined images from a text prompt and up to five input images using Ideogram 4.5, where image 1 is the image to edit and images 2-5 are references for design, material, or colour. Canvas size, quality level, and seed are adjustable, and one image is output. Ideal for product and outfit swaps, applying a reference design or palette to an existing photo, and recomposing a shot into a different aspect ratio.

metadata.name: api_ideogram_v4_5_precise_image_edit
metadata.title: Ideogram 4.5 Precise Edit
metadata.description: Generate a precisely edited image from a text prompt and up to five input images using Ideogram 4.5, where image 1 is the image to edit and images 2-5 are optional references. Only what the prompt asks for changes, so untouched pixels stay identical and the output keeps the size of image 1, with a choice of quality tiers. Ideal for product recolours and material swaps, replacing one element of a photo without disturbing its lighting, background, or framing, and touch-ups that must leave the rest of the image alone.

metadata.name: api_ideogram_v4_5_t2i
metadata.title: Ideogram 4.5: Text to Image
metadata.description: Generate images from text prompts using Ideogram 4.5, with controls for canvas size, quality level, automatic prompt rewriting, and seed. No file inputs are required and one image is output. Ideal for typography-led posters, layout-driven design work, marketing visuals, and fast exploration of visual concepts.

metadata.name: api_ideogram_v4_t2i
metadata.title: Ideogram v4: Text to Image (API)
metadata.description: Input a text prompt in structured JSON format. Generate a high-quality image with precise layout control, text rendering, and color palette support.

metadata.name: api_ideogram_vector_1_image_to_svg
metadata.title: Ideogram Vector 1: Image to SVG
metadata.description: Trace a bitmap into a fully editable SVG with Ideogram Vector 1 and save it as one vector file. Ideal for turning logos, flat illustration, patterns and line art into clean paths that stay crisp at any size, with a detail mode that either keeps large flat color blocks or finer color regions. Photographs also work, but convert into many small paths, so clean sources with large areas of flat color and transparent backgrounds vectorize best.

metadata.name: api_ideogram_vector_1_text_to_svg
metadata.title: Ideogram Vector 1: Text to SVG
metadata.description: Generate a fully editable SVG from a text prompt with Ideogram Vector 1, optionally guided by up to five reference images, and save it as one vector file. Ideal for logos, posters, flat illustration, patterns and line art that stays crisp at any size and opens directly in a vector editor.

metadata.name: api_kling2_6_i2v
metadata.title: Kling2.6: Animate Images with Audio
metadata.description: Transform static images into dynamic videos with synchronized dialogue, singing, sound effects, and ambient audio.

metadata.name: api_kling2_6_t2v
metadata.title: Kling2.6: Storytelling Videos with Audio
metadata.description: Bring your stories to life with videos featuring synchronized dialogue, music, sound effects, and ambient audio from text prompts.

metadata.name: api_kling4_i2v
metadata.title: Kling 4.0: Image to Video
metadata.description: Animate a single still into a five-second clip with Kling 4.0, cutting three times inside one generation. The source image locks the subject and styling while the default prompt drives the camera moves and a beat-timed edit, and the model also produces stereo audio. Ideal for fashion, editorial, and product motion where the input frame defines the look.

metadata.name: api_kling4_r2v
metadata.title: Kling 4.0: Reference to Video
metadata.description: Hold a character and a location from two reference images and shoot a three-shot fashion fragment between them: an extreme close-up with a snap zoom, a mid-hall turn with a whip-pan, and a 120-degree orbit under the arched window. Each cut lands on a new position inside the same room, with two hard cuts in five seconds and stereo audio generated for the space.

metadata.name: api_kling4_t2v
metadata.title: Kling 4.0: Text to Video
metadata.description: Generate a ten-second cinematic clip from text alone with Kling 4.0, holding one single continuous shot through a full high-speed chase while also producing native stereo audio. Ideal for short-form spectacle, concept pitches, and motion references where a single unbroken take carries the idea.

metadata.name: api_kling4_video_edit
metadata.title: Kling 4.0: Video Edit
metadata.description: Edit an existing clip in one pass with Kling 4.0: name the change and list what must survive, and the model rewrites only that part while keeping the subject, costume, shot count, camera work and timing intact. Output inherits the input's length and aspect ratio, and stereo audio is regenerated to match the new scene. Ideal for swapping environments, wardrobe or style on footage that is already cut.

metadata.name: api_kling_motion_control
metadata.title: Kling2.6: Motion Control
metadata.description: Apply precise character actions and expressions from a reference video to your character image with synchronized motion control.

metadata.name: api_kling_motion_control3
metadata.title: Kling 3.0: Motion Control
metadata.description: Upload a character image and a motion reference video. Generate a new video where your character performs the actions from the reference, with enhanced facial consistency using optional element binding.

metadata.name: api_kling_o3_flf2v
metadata.title: Kling O3: FLF2V
metadata.description: Upload reference images or specify start and end frames. Generate a video with precise semantic control, longer duration, and improved narrative coherence.

metadata.name: api_kling_o3_i2v
metadata.title: Kling O3: Reference to Video
metadata.description: Upload a reference image and optional audio or text prompt. Generate a character-consistent video with native audio output and precise storyboard control.

metadata.name: api_kling_o3_image
metadata.title: Kling O3: Image Generation
metadata.description: Upload up to 10 reference images to guide the synthesis. Generate a new image using the Kling O3 model based on your provided visual inputs.

metadata.name: api_kling_o3_t2v
metadata.title: Kling O3: Text to Video
metadata.description: Upload text, audio, or images to generate a 15-second video with synchronized audio, character consistency, and storyboard control.

metadata.name: api_kling_o3_video_edit
metadata.title: Kling O3: Video Edit
metadata.description: Upload a video and a reference image to edit with Kling O3. Generate a professionally edited video with precise subject editing, scene composition, and native audio-visual synchronization.

metadata.name: api_kling_omni_edit_video
metadata.title: Kling O1: Video Edit
metadata.description: Edit videos with natural language commands, featuring video reference mode for quick generation of high-quality style transfers, element additions, and background modifications.

metadata.name: api_kling_omni_i2v
metadata.title: Kling O1: Image to Video
metadata.description: Transform static images into dynamic videos with Kling O1. Add motion, camera movements, and life to your images using text prompts.

metadata.name: api_kling_omni_image
metadata.title: Kling O1: Image
metadata.description: Generate high-quality images from text prompts using Kling O1, with support for up to 10 reference images to guide style and content. Features flexible aspect ratios and 1K/2K resolution options.

metadata.name: api_kling_omni_t2v
metadata.title: Kling O1: Text to Video
metadata.description: Generate videos from text descriptions using Kling O1. Create dynamic video content with natural language prompts.

metadata.name: api_kling_omni_v2v
metadata.title: Kling O1: Video to Video
metadata.description: Transform videos with Kling O1. Edit video content, change styles, or replace characters using text prompts and reference images.

metadata.name: api_kling_v3_flf2v
metadata.title: Kling 3.0: First Last Frame to Video
metadata.description: Input a first and last frame image to generate a continuous video sequence with multi-shot generation, precise element control, and support for multilingual prompts.

metadata.name: api_kling_v3_t2i
metadata.title: Kling 3.0: Text to Image
metadata.description: Generate an image from a text prompt using the Kling 3.0 model. Input your descriptive text to receive a high-quality, prompt-accurate visual output.

metadata.name: api_kling_v3_video
metadata.title: Kling 3.0: Video Generation
metadata.description: Input text or image prompts to generate 15-second video sequences with multi-shot compositions, complex camera movements, and consistent subjects.

metadata.name: api_kling_vto
metadata.title: Kling: Virtual Try On
metadata.description: Dress a virtual model in any garment by combining a clothing image with a person photo, generating a realistic try-on result alongside a side-by-side comparison view. It accepts flat-lay, mannequin, or on-model clothing shots while preserving the model's face and pose. Ideal for fashion e-commerce previews, styling mockups, and virtual fitting experiences.

metadata.name: api_krea2_style_reference
metadata.title: Krea 2: Style Reference
metadata.description: Upload a style reference image and input a text prompt. Generate an image matching the prompt while applying the aesthetic style from your reference.

metadata.name: api_krea2_t2i
metadata.title: Krea2: Text to Image
metadata.description: Input a text prompt describing your desired scene. Generate four aesthetic, high-quality images that interpret your prompt with creative variety.

metadata.name: api_krea3_image_edit
metadata.title: Krea 3: Image Edit
metadata.description: Perform targeted regional edits on an image with Krea 3, changing only the areas you specify while the rest of the picture stays untouched. One image goes in and one edited image comes out. Ideal for e-commerce product restaging, fashion and portrait relighting, and architectural sketch-to-render work.

metadata.name: api_krea3_t2i
metadata.title: Krea 3: Text to Image
metadata.description: Generate images from text prompts using Krea 3, producing a single finished image per run with no input files required. Ideal for e-commerce product staging, fashion and portrait work, and architectural concept rendering.

metadata.name: api_ltx2_5_flf2v
metadata.title: LTX-2.5 (Pro): FLF2V
metadata.description: Generate a video from two reference images using LTX-2.5, blending the content of both frames into a single animated sequence. Ideal for creating transition shots, morphing between two subjects or scenes, and building multi-shot narratives from still references.

metadata.name: api_ltx2_5_i2v
metadata.title: LTX-2.5 (Pro): Image to Video
metadata.description: Generate video from a single image using LTX-2.5's fast distilled model, delivering cinematic multi-shot sequences with consistent characters, lighting, and style across cuts. The workflow outputs a video file with native multishot support and automatic duration prediction. Ideal for rapid storyboarding, social media content creation, and pre-visualization in commercial production pipelines.

metadata.name: api_ltx2_5_t2v
metadata.title: LTX-2.5 (Pro): Text to Video
metadata.description: Generate video from text with LTX 2.5, a video model built for fast, high-quality production work. Type a prompt and get a cinematic clip with sharp detail, accurate motion, and support for native multishot scenes that hold character and style across cuts.

metadata.name: api_luma_photon_i2i
metadata.title: Luma Photon: Image to Image
metadata.description: Guide image generation using a combination of images and prompt.

metadata.name: api_luma_photon_style_ref
metadata.title: Luma Photon: Style Reference
metadata.description: Generate images by blending style references with precise control using Luma Photon.

metadata.name: api_luma_ray3_2_video_edit
metadata.title: Luma Ray 3.2: Video Edit
metadata.description: Edit videos using natural language commands with Luma Ray 3.2, processing one input video and generating an edited output based on your textual instructions.

metadata.name: api_luma_ray3_3_i2v
metadata.title: Luma Ray 3.2: Image to Video
metadata.description: Generate cinematic-quality videos from text prompts using Luma Ray 3.2, with support for extending previous generations by providing a generation ID. The workflow accepts 1 input image and produces 1 video output, enabling seamless iterative refinement. Ideal for creating short film sequences, marketing content, and professional video production.

metadata.name: api_luma_ray3_3_t2v
metadata.title: Luma Ray 3.2: Text to Video
metadata.description: Generate cinematic-quality videos from text prompts using Luma Ray 3.2, with optional video extension by providing a generation ID from a previous run. Ideal for creating short film sequences, marketing content, and iterative video refinement.

metadata.name: api_luma_uni_1_image_create
metadata.title: Luma UNI-1: Image Creation
metadata.description: Generate brand-new original images using the Luma UNI-1 node with up to 9 reference images for style, character, color, lighting, and composition. Create unique compositions with detailed prompts, adjustable aspect ratios, and seed control.

metadata.name: api_luma_uni_1_image_edit
metadata.title: Luma UNI-1: Image Edit
metadata.description: Edit existing images with Uni-1's Image Edit mode, preserving composition and core elements. Supports targeted adjustments like lighting and color using prompts and reference images.

metadata.name: api_magnific_image_relight
metadata.title: Relight: Magnific
metadata.description: Upload a source image and a reference lighting image. Generate a relit version of your source image, applying the lighting conditions from the reference.

metadata.name: api_magnific_image_style_transfer
metadata.title: Magnific: Style Reference
metadata.description: Upload a target image and a style reference image. Generate a new image that merges the artistic style of the reference with the structure of your target.

metadata.name: api_magnific_image_upscale_creative
metadata.title: Image Upscale: Magnific Creative
metadata.description: Upload an image and set the magnification level. Generate an upscaled version of your image with support for up to 16x enlargement.

metadata.name: api_magnific_image_upscale_precise
metadata.title: Image Upscale: Magnific Precise
metadata.description: Upload an image to precisely upscale it using the Magnific model, generating a high-resolution version with enhanced detail.

metadata.name: api_magnific_skin_enhancer
metadata.title: Portrait Enhancement: Magnific
metadata.description: Enhance skin and overall image quality by uploading your image and selecting a preset to adjust lighting, color grading, and realism.

metadata.name: api_meshy7_1_image_to_model
metadata.title: Meshy 7.1: Image to 3D
metadata.description: Generate a 3D model from a single image using Meshy 7.1's Ultra 4K geometry mode, which produces 4096³ meshes so fine surface detail like stitching, wood grain, and scales becomes real geometry rather than texture. Takes one input image. Ideal for high-fidelity asset creation, detailed prop modeling, and product visualization.

metadata.name: api_meshy7_1_text_to_model
metadata.title: Meshy 7.1: Text to Model
metadata.description: Generate detailed 3D models from text prompts using Meshy 7.1, with an optional Ultra 4K geometry mode that captures fine surface detail like stitching, wood grain, and scales as real geometry. Ideal for game asset creation, product visualization, and 3D printing preparation.

metadata.name: api_meshy7_image_to_model
metadata.title: Meshy 7: Image to 3D
metadata.description: Turn a single image into a production-ready 3D model with Meshy 7, generating a textured mesh that faithfully mirrors your reference's geometry, proportions, and surface details. metadata.description: Generate cinematic video from two reference images using Seedance 2.0 Mini, producing a single video output with AI-driven camera motion and consistent character generation. Ideal for storytelling, branded content, and short film creation where shot composition and visual continuity are essential.

metadata.name: api_seedance2_0_mini_t2v
metadata.title: Seedance 2.0 Mini: Text to Video
metadata.description: Generate cinematic videos from text prompts with Dreamina’s Seedance 2.0 Mini, supporting AI camera controls and consistent character generation across scenes. This workflow takes only prompt input and produces 1 video output. Ideal for AI filmmaking, branded content creation, and multi-shot storytelling projects.

metadata.name: api_seedance2_0_r2v
metadata.title: Seedance 2.0: Reference to Video
metadata.description: Generate cinematic videos from reference images and text prompts. Preserve subject identity and composition while adding expressive motion with synchronized audio. Control camera movement and lighting through detailed prompts.

metadata.name: api_seedance2_0_r2v_4k
metadata.title: Seedance2.0 4K: Reference to Video
metadata.description: Generate a reference-based video from a single input image using Seedance 2.0, producing native 4K output with 10-bit color depth and clean fine detail retention. The workflow takes 1 image and outputs 1 video. Ideal for high-resolution motion graphics, cinematic VFX shots requiring downstream grading, and professional video production where 4K finishing is essential.

metadata.name: api_seedance2_0_r2v_real_human
metadata.title: Seedance2.0 Real Human: Reference to Video
metadata.description: Upload a reference video of a real person for identity verification. Use your own photo to validate and generate a personalized video output.

metadata.name: api_seedance2_0_t2v
metadata.title: Seedance 2.0: Text to Video
metadata.description: Generate cinematic videos from text prompts with synchronized audio, controlled camera motion, and stable visuals. Input text descriptions to output high-quality video sequences.

metadata.name: api_seedance2_5_draft_i2v
metadata.title: Seedance2.5 Draft: Image to Video
metadata.description: Generate draft preview videos from a first frame image using Seedance 2.5's two-phase draft mode: stage one turns your image into a fast, low-cost 480p preview plus a reusable draft task ID, and stage two renders the 1080p final from that ID. Ideal for testing motion, camera and scene ideas on a still before committing to a full-quality render.

metadata.name: api_seedance2_5_draft_r2v
metadata.title: Seedance2.5 Draft: Reference to Video
metadata.description: Generate draft preview videos from reference images using Seedance 2.5's two-phase draft mode: stage one turns your references and prompt into a fast, low-cost 480p preview plus a reusable draft task ID, and stage two renders the 1080p final from that ID. Ideal for locking in a character or storyboard reference before committing to a full-quality render.

metadata.name: api_seedance2_5_draft_t2v
metadata.title: Seedance2.5 Draft: Text to Video
metadata.description: Generate draft preview videos from text prompts using Seedance 2.5's two-phase draft mode: stage one turns your prompt into a fast, low-cost 480p preview plus a reusable draft task ID, and stage two renders the 1080p final from that ID. Ideal for storyboard testing, rapid creative iteration, and budget-conscious production workflows.

metadata.name: api_seedance2_5_flf2v
metadata.title: Seedance 2.5: FLF2V
metadata.description: Generate a smooth video transition between a user-provided start frame and end frame with Seedance 2.5, which automatically interpolates the motion, camera movement, and visual evolution while locking both endpoints. Ideal for shot transitions, storyboard previz, and before-and-after scene showcases like empty-to-packed or day-to-night shifts.

metadata.name: api_seedance2_5_i2v_1080p
metadata.title: Seedance2.5 1080P: Image to Video
metadata.description: Generate cinematic 1080P video clips from a single image using Seedance 2.5, animating the still into a moving scene with synchronized sound, music, and dialogue for clips up to 30 seconds across any aspect ratio. Ideal for breathing life into product shots, extending concept art into motion, and creating engaging social media content from photographs.

metadata.name: api_seedance2_5_r2v
metadata.title: Seedance 2.5: Reference to Video
metadata.description: Generate reference-driven videos with Seedance 2.5 by supplying up to 20 images, 6 video clips, and 6 audio clips to control character consistency, visual style, and motion rhythm in a single 4–30 second output with synchronized sound and lip-synced dialogue. Ideal for e-commerce product showcases, brand advertising, and character-driven short series.

metadata.name: api_seedance2_5_t2v
metadata.title: Seedance 2.5: Text to Video
metadata.description: Generate 30-second cinematic videos from text prompts with Seedance 2.5, producing synchronized sound and music alongside the footage. Input a single text prompt to create one video with precise camera control and multi-shot storytelling. Ideal for brand films, episodic series, and e-commerce content where quality matters more than budget.

metadata.name: api_seedance2_5_t2v_1080p
metadata.title: Seedance2.5 1080P: Text to Video
metadata.description: Generate cinematic 1080P video clips from text descriptions using Seedance 2.5, supporting clips up to 30 seconds with synchronized sound, music, and dialogue across any aspect ratio. Ideal for short comedy scenes, product showcases, and creative storytelling.

metadata.name: api_seedance2_5_video_editing
metadata.title: Seedance2.5: Video Editing
metadata.description: Edit existing video clips with Seedance 2.5 by describing changes in natural language, enabling local object removal, background swaps, scene replacements, and style transfers while preserving the original composition and motion. Feed in 1 video and receive 1 edited video output with temporally consistent results across frames. Ideal for e-commerce background replacement, stylized remakes of footage, and ad re-editing with targeted retouching.

metadata.name: api_seedance2_5_video_extend
metadata.title: Video Extend: Seedance 2.5
metadata.description: Extend an existing video forward or backward by generating new segments that seamlessly preserve the original characters, scenes, and aspect ratio. The source video must be 1.9–30 seconds long, and you specify the duration of the new clip (4–30 seconds, default 5), with output delivered as MP4 or MOV. Ideal for continuing unfinished footage, creating extended narrative sequences, and building longer edit chains.

metadata.name: api_sonilo_t2m
metadata.title: Sonilo: Text to Music Generation
metadata.description: Generate high-quality, production-ready music from text prompts. Input descriptive text to create original soundtracks with streaming playback and precise duration control.

metadata.name: api_sonilo_v2m
metadata.title: Sonilo: Video Soundtrack Generation
metadata.description: Generate synchronized soundtracks from video footage. Input a video to produce music that matches its pacing and emotional cues, outputting a perfectly timed audio file.

metadata.name: api_sync_so_lip_sync_video
metadata.title: Sync 3: Video Lip-Sync
metadata.description: Synchronize a video's lip movements with a new audio track using the Sync Labs sync-3 model, which automatically adjusts the speaker’s mouth to match your uploaded audio. This workflow takes 1 video and 1 audio input to produce 1 synced video output. Ideal for dubbing foreign-language content, correcting mismatched dialogue in video production, or animating a static portrait to speak.

metadata.name: api_sync_so_talking_image
metadata.title: Sync 3: Talking Image
metadata.description: Generate a talking-head video from a single face photo and an audio clip, with lips and lower-face motion precisely synchronized to the speech. This process outputs one video from one image and one audio input, keeping hands, products, and background completely unchanged. Ideal for product demos, e-commerce introductions, and marketing videos where a static product-holding photo is paired with a voiceover.

metadata.name: api_tencent_hy_image_3_5_preview_image_edit

metadata.description: Edit images with the HY Image 3.5 Preview model, which deeply understands user intent through optimized text-and-image organization to deliver high-quality results. Takes 1 image input and produces 1 image output. Ideal for portrait editing, commercial posters, and film/TV marketing materials.

metadata.name: api_tencent_hy_image_3_5_preview_t2i
metadata.title: HY Image 3.5 Preview: Text to Image
metadata.description: Tencent Hunyuan's preview image model, strengthening three areas over previous versions: multilingual text rendering and typesetting for advertising, infographics and UI design; photorealism and stylistic range covering cinematic, comic, commercial photography and illustration; and editing consistency that preserves key traits of people and products across background, outfit and style changes. Outputs up to 4K resolution.

metadata.name: api_topaz_astra2
metadata.title: Video Upscale: Topaz Astra 2 Creative

metadata.name: api_topaz_image_enhance

metadata.name: api_topaz_image_enhance_bloom2

metadata.description: Enhance AI-generated images with Bloom 2, a creative upscaling model that adds new detail, texture, and visual elements while offering a Creativity control from 1–9 for subtle refinement or bold reinterpretation. It accepts 1 input image and produces 1 enhanced output, with optional Face Recovery, Color Preservation, and grain settings for fine-tuned results. Ideal for improving AI artwork and illustrations, adding realism to CG renders, and refining facial detail in generated portraits.

metadata.name: api_topaz_image_enhance_wonder3_5
metadata.title: Image Upscale: Topaz Wonder 3.5
metadata.description: Upscale and enhance a single image using Topaz's Wonder 3.5 generative model, which adds fine detail, reduces noise, and sharpens text and structured graphics while offering Low, Medium, and High enhancement strengths. The workflow takes 1 input image and produces 1 enhanced output alongside a side-by-side comparison view. Ideal for restoring old or compressed photos, improving product shots and marketing visuals, and preparing low-resolution images for print or large-format display.

metadata.name: api_topaz_starlight_precise25
metadata.title: Video Upscale: Topaz Starlight Precise 2.5

metadata.description: Remove background noise from a speech recording with VEED Clean Audio: music and effects go with the noise, pauses are cleaned completely, and the voice comes back as 48 kHz mono audio, optionally normalized to a target loudness. Audio up to 1799 seconds.

metadata.name: api_veed_clean_audio_video
metadata.title: VEED Clean Audio: Video Speech Cleanup
metadata.description: Clean the speech inside a video with VEED Clean Audio: background noise, music and effects are stripped from the soundtrack, pauses are cleaned completely, and the clip comes back with 48 kHz mono speech, optionally normalized to a target loudness while the picture stays as shot. Video up to 1799 seconds.

metadata.name: api_veed_dubbing
metadata.title: VEED Dubbing: Video Translation
metadata.description: Translate the speech in a video into another language with VEED Dubbing: each speaker's voice is cloned and their lips are re-synced to the translation. Pick between the cheaper standard tier and pro, which adds regional accents and stereo audio. Built for footage with a visible face and a talk track.

metadata.name: api_veed_fabric_1_0
metadata.title: VEED Fabric 1.0: Talking Photo
metadata.description: Turn a still photo and a speech track into a talking, lip-synced video with VEED Fabric 1.0. The face in the image speaks the audio, the clip keeps the image's aspect ratio and runs as long as the audio, up to 300 seconds at 480p or 720p. Ideal for avatars, mascots and localized spokesperson clips driven by your own voice recording or a TTS node.

metadata.name: api_veed_lipsync_2_0
metadata.title: VEED Lipsync 2.0: Lip Sync
metadata.description: Re-sync a speaker's mouth in footage you already shot to a new speech track with VEED Lipsync 2.0. The person on camera speaks the new audio while the rest of the shot stays as recorded; the output keeps the video's resolution at 25 fps and runs as long as the audio, up to 600 seconds. If the clip is shorter than the speech it plays forward and backward until the audio ends. Ideal for dubbing a line, swapping a script without re-shooting, or making localized versions of existing footage.

metadata.name: api_veed_remove_video_background
metadata.title: VEED Remove Video Background: Matte Export
metadata.description: Cut the subject out of a video with VEED Remove Video Background: the node segments the foreground in every frame and returns the frames plus an alpha mask, and Join Image with Alpha turns that mask into a transparent PNG sequence ready to composite. Choose standard, fast or green-screen keying; clips up to 60 seconds.

metadata.description: Upload a video to upscale it using a fast GAN model. The output resolution is determined by your chosen model (e.g., 2x or 4x). For best results, upscale first, then resize to your target resolution.

metadata.title: Lineart Map: LineArt Preprocessor
