metadata.title: Pose Map: DWPose OpenPose
metadata.description: Convert a Video to a temporally stable Pose Control Map

metadata.name: utility-topaz_landscape_upscaler
metadata.title: Image Upscale: Topaz Reimagine Landscape
metadata.description: Upload a landscape image to upscale and enhance details. Generate a high-resolution output optimized for natural scenery using Topaz Reimagine.

metadata.name: utility_birefnet_remove_background
metadata.title: Remove Background: BiRefNet
metadata.description: Upload an image with any background. Generate a version with the background removed and a precision segmentation mask.

metadata.name: utility_bria_increase_resolution
metadata.title: Image Upscale: Bria Increase Resolution
metadata.description: Upscale any image to higher resolutions using Bria's dedicated resolution enhancement API, which preserves original content without adding new details or regenerating the image. The workflow accepts a single input image and produces one enhanced, higher-resolution output, supporting JPEG and PNG files in RGB, RGBA, or CMYK color modes up to a maximum area of 8192x8192 pixels. Built-in content moderation scans both the input image and generated output to ensure safe, policy-compliant processing. Ideal for preparing images for print, enlarging photos for digital display, or increasing resolution of assets for professional design work.

metadata.name: utility_bria_remove_image_background
metadata.title: Remove Background: Bria
metadata.description: Upload an image to automatically remove its background using the Bria API. The workflow processes the request asynchronously and returns the edited image with a transparent background.

metadata.name: utility_depth_anything3_image_depth_estimation
metadata.title: Depth Estimation: Depth Anything 3
metadata.description: Upload 1 image. Generate a depth map using Depth Anything 3 and view a side-by-side comparison of the original and depth output. Ideal for 3D scene reconstruction, AR/VR asset preparation, and visual effects depth passes.

metadata.name: utility_depth_anything3_video_depth_estimation
metadata.title: Depth Map: Depth Anything 3
metadata.description: Upload 1 image to generate a depth map for video depth estimation. Output a single depth-processed image ready for use in downstream workflows. Ideal for video generation tasks requiring depth control, 3D scene preprocessing, and animation depth mapping.

metadata.name: utility_face_detection_mediapipe
metadata.title: Face Detection: MediaPipe
metadata.description: Input an image and detect up to 6 facial landmarks per face, enabling ultrafast multi-face detection

metadata.name: utility_gimm_frame_interpolation
metadata.title: Frame Interpolation: GIMM-VFI
metadata.description: Generate intermediate frames between existing video frames to create smoother motion. Input a video and receive a fluid, higher-frame-rate output without changing the total duration.

metadata.name: utility_hitpaw_general_image_enhance
metadata.title: Image Upscale: HitPaw Portrait
metadata.description: Upload a low-quality portrait image and adjust the upscaling factor. Generate a high-fidelity, detailed portrait with enhanced skin textures and facial features.

metadata.name: utility_hitpaw_video_enhance
metadata.title: Video Upscale: HitPaw
metadata.description: Upload a video to enhance and upscale. Generate a restored output with improved clarity, temporal stability, and optional portrait enhancement.

metadata.name: utility_image_segment_sam3
metadata.title: Image Segmentation: SAM3
metadata.description: Use the SAM3 model to segment the main subject or content from a photo or image, isolating specific objects or regions. Input an image and receive a segmented mask output.

metadata.name: utility_image_stitch
metadata.title: Image Stitch 2x2 Grid
metadata.description: Combine four input images into a 2x2 grid. Automatically resizes mismatched images and outputs a single 2048x2048 image.

metadata.name: utility_image_upscale_supir
metadata.title: Image Restoration: SUPIR
metadata.description: Restore and enhance images using SUPIR's generative prior and text guidance. Accepts image and optional text prompts for intelligent restoration with high-quality results.

metadata.name: utility_interpolation_image_upscale
metadata.title: Image Upscale: Traditional Interpolation
metadata.description: Upload an image and select an interpolation method. Upscale the image using traditional algorithms for faster processing with minimal detail changes.

metadata.name: utility_moge3_geometry_estimation
metadata.title: Geometry Estimation: MoGe 3
metadata.description: Estimate fine-detailed geometry from a single image with MoGe 3, the sparse-volumetric refinement version of MoGe. It lifts a coarse point map onto a sparse voxel shell and refines depth with lightweight sparse 3D convolutions, keeping thin structures and depth discontinuities that image-space decoders blur. Ships with the ViT-L checkpoint; the ViT-G file is selectable in the same Load MoGe Model dropdown for higher fine-detail accuracy. Takes 1 image input and outputs 1 depth map and 1 normal map.

metadata.name: utility_moge_depth_estimation
metadata.title: Depth Estimation: MoGe
metadata.description: Upload a single RGB image and adjust inference resolution and batch size. Generate a colored depth preview and raw depth map,

metadata.name: utility_nanobanana_pro_ai_image_fix
metadata.title: Image Upscale: Nano Banana Pro
metadata.description: Upload an AI-generated image to upscale and enhance details. Generate a 4K output with improved sharpness and coherence using Nano Banana Pro.

metadata.name: utility_nanobanana_pro_illustration_upscale
metadata.title: Image Upscale: Nano Banana Pro Illustration
metadata.description: Upload a stylized art or illustration. Generate a creatively upscaled 4K image with enhanced detail using the Nano Banana Pro model, ideal for marketing or gaming assets.

metadata.name: utility_nanobanana_pro_product_upscale
metadata.title: Image Upscale: Nano Banana Pro Product
metadata.description: Upload a product image to enhance its detail and sharpness. Generate an upscaled, high-quality output with improved typography and realistic coherence using the Nano Banana Pro model.

metadata.name: utility_nvidia_rtx_video_enhance
metadata.title: RTX Video Enhance: HDR
metadata.description: Upload a video and chain Nvidia's three RTX video nodes in one pass: super resolution upscale, frame generation and SDR-to-HDR conversion, running locally on your Nvidia RTX GPU. Built for VFX artists and professional video creators.

metadata.name: utility_pid_latent_upscale_dit
metadata.title: Image Upscale: PiD Latent Decode
metadata.description: Input a latent image from a diffusion model and select a PiD checkpoint. Generate a high-resolution decoded image with 4x or 8x upscaling in a single pass.

metadata.name: utility_recraft_creative_image_upscale
metadata.title: Image Upscale: Recraft Creative
metadata.description: Upload an image to enhance and upscale it. Recraft's AI reconstructs details and improves textures, outputting a higher-quality image with a natural appearance.

metadata.name: utility_recraft_crisp_image_upscale
metadata.title: Image Upscale: Recraft Crisp
metadata.description: Upload a low-resolution or noisy image to restore and upscale. Generate a high-resolution output with enhanced details, reduced artifacts, and preserved natural look.

metadata.name: utility_sam3d_body
metadata.title: SAM 3D Body: 3D Human Mesh Extraction From Video
metadata.description: Extract a full-body 3D human mesh from a single video frame using SAM 3D Body, guided by a text prompt to refine pose and shape estimation. The workflow loads one video and one text prompt, then outputs a reconstructed video showing the recovered human rig. Ideal for motion capture prototyping, biomechanics analysis, and character animation previsualization.

metadata.name: utility_sdpose_multi_person
metadata.title: Pose Detection: SDPose Multi-Person
metadata.description: Upload an image to detect human poses. Supports detection for both single individuals and multiple people within the same scene.

metadata.name: utility_sdpose_multi_person_video

metadata.description: Upload a video to detect human poses. Supports detection for both single individuals and multiple people within the same scene

metadata.name: utility_sdpose_ood_image_to_pose
metadata.title: Pose Map: SDPose-OOD
metadata.description: Upload an image to extract pose keypoints and generate a corresponding pose map using the SDPose-OOD model.

metadata.name: utility_sdpose_ood_video_to_pose_map
metadata.title: Pose Map: SDPose-OOD
metadata.description: Upload a video to extract pose keypoints and generate a pose map. The workflow supports multiple person detection and uses an enhanced SDPose model for accurate whole-body feature extraction.

metadata.name: utility_seedvr2_3b_int8_upscale_image
metadata.title: Image Upscale: SeedVR2 3B Int8
metadata.description: Upscale images using SeedVR2 3B Int8, a one-step diffusion-based video restoration model that produces high-quality results with improved temporal consistency. Ideal for restoring degraded footage, upscaling low-resolution videos, and enhancing archival media.

metadata.name: utility_seedvr2_3b_int8_upscale_video
metadata.title: Video Upscale: SeedVR2 3B Int8
metadata.description: Upscale and restore video footage using SeedVR2 3B Int8, a one-step diffusion model that enhances resolution while maintaining temporal consistency across frames. This workflow takes one degraded video as input and outputs a single high-resolution, restored video. Ideal for restoring old or degraded footage, upscaling low-resolution videos, and enhancing archival media.

metadata.name: utility_seedvr2_7b_int8_upscale_image
metadata.title: Image Upscale: SeedVR2 7B Int8
metadata.description: Upscale images using SeedVR2 7B Int8, a one-step diffusion model that enhances resolution through adversarial training and adaptive window attention. Input 1 image and receive 1 upscaled output with improved detail and clarity. Ideal for restoring low-resolution photos, preparing assets for print, or sharpening lightly degraded digital images.

metadata.name: utility_seedvr2_image_upscale
metadata.title: Image Upscale: SeedVR2
metadata.description: Upload an image to upscale it with SeedVR2 and generate a high-definition output.

metadata.name: utility_seedvr2_video_upscale
metadata.title: Video Upscale: SeedVR2
metadata.description: Upload a video to upscale and enhance its resolution using the SeedVR2 model for high-definition output.

metadata.description: Upload an image to upscale it to 2K resolution using the Z-Image-Turbo model.

metadata.name: video_bernini_r_image_editing
metadata.title: Bernini-R: Image Edit
metadata.description: Generate an edited image with matched lighting and view a side-by-side before/after comparison. Ideal for portrait and product relighting, consistent lighting across photo sets, and e-commerce catalog photography.

metadata.name: video_bernini_r_video_editing
metadata.title: Bernini-R: Video Edit
metadata.description: Generate an edited video with consistent relighting using Bernini-R. Ideal for portrait and product relighting, e-commerce catalog photography, and creating consistent lighting across photo sets.

metadata.name: video_capybara_v0_1_image_to_video

metadata.name: video_causal_forcing_i2v
metadata.title: Causal Forcing: Image to Video
metadata.description: Input a text prompt and select a model checkpoint. Generate a high-quality video using Causal Forcing or Causal Forcing++ with 1 to 4 inference steps.

metadata.name: video_fasth3_ominiref_r2v
metadata.title: FastH3 OmniRef: Reference to Video
metadata.description: Generate synchronized video with matching audio from a text prompt plus a reference image using the FastH3 OmniRef eight-step distilled model, which renders both streams in just eight sampling steps. Takes 1 input image and produces 1 video output. Ideal for animating reference characters, creating talking avatars, and rapid social media video prototyping.

metadata.name: video_fastvideo_fasth3_i2v
metadata.title: FastVideo FastH3: Image to Video
metadata.description: Generate video with synchronized native audio from a single still image using MiniMax H3 and the FastH3 8-step checkpoint. One image produces one video output with matching voice, sound effects, and music in a single pass. Ideal for animating portraits, bringing product shots to life, and quick social media clips.

metadata.name: video_fastvideo_fasth3_t2v
metadata.title: FastVideo FastH3: Text to Video
metadata.description: Generate synchronized video and audio directly from text using a distilled eight-step model, producing one video output with no file inputs required. Ideal for rapid text-to-video prototyping, audio-visual content creation, and creative storytelling where fast generation matters more than maximum detail.

metadata.name: video_humo
metadata.title: HuMo Video Generation
metadata.description: Generate videos based on audio, image, and text, keeping the character's lip sync.

metadata.name: video_hunyuan_video_1.5_720p_i2v
metadata.title: Hunyuan Video 1.5 Image to Video
metadata.description: Animate still images into dynamic videos with precise motion and camera control. Maintains visual consistency while bringing photos and illustrations to life with smooth, natural movements.

metadata.name: video_hunyuan_video_1.5_720p_t2v
metadata.title: Hunyuan Video 1.5 Text to Video
metadata.description: Generate high-quality 720p videos from text prompts with cinematic camera control, emotional expressions, and physics simulation. Supports multiple styles including realistic, anime, and 3D with text rendering.

metadata.name: video_kandinsky5_i2v

metadata.name: video_kandinsky5_t2v

metadata.description: A lightweight 2B model that generates videos from English and Russian prompts with high visual quality.

metadata.name: video_ltx2_3_flf2v
metadata.title: LTX-2.3: FLF2V

metadata.name: video_ltx2_3_i2v
metadata.title: LTX-2.3: Image to Video
metadata.description: Upload an image to generate a video with improved motion consistency and fine details, including enhanced support for portrait formats and audio quality.

metadata.name: video_ltx2_3_ia2v
metadata.title: LTX-2.3: Image Audio to Video
metadata.description: Upload an image and an audio file to generate a high-quality video with synchronized lip movements using LTX-2.3.

metadata.name: video_ltx2_3_ic_lora
metadata.title: LTX 2.3 IC-LoRA Union Control
metadata.description: Generate LTX 2.3 videos with IC-LoRA using aligned control inputs like depth, pose, or edges.

metadata.name: video_ltx2_3_id_lora
metadata.title: LTX-2.3: ID LoRA
metadata.description: Generate personalized videos with synchronized audio from a text prompt, reference image, and short audio clip. Use ID-LoRA to adapt a person's appearance and voice in a single generative model.

metadata.name: video_ltx2_3_t2v
metadata.title: LTX-2.3: Text to Video
metadata.description: Generate a video from a text prompt, optionally using an image for reference. Receive a high-quality video with improved motion, audio, and detail, optimized for portrait or landscape formats.

metadata.name: video_ltx2_5_dfr_i2v
metadata.title: LTX-2.5 DFR: Image to Video
metadata.description: Generate a short video with sound from a single image using LTX-2.5's DFR (Diffusion Fidelity Rendering) path: a half-resolution pass that carries generated detailing keyframes, a spatial x2 detailing pass with the pixel-spatial IC-LoRA, and an optional temporal x2 pass. Suited to cinematic shots, character beats and talking-image clips that need motion and synchronized audio.

metadata.name: video_ltx2_5_flf2v
metadata.title: LTX-2.5: FLF2V
metadata.description: Generate a video from first and last frame reference images using LTX-2.5, blending both frames into a single animated sequence. Ideal for creating transition shots, morphing between two subjects or scenes, and building multi-shot narratives from still references.

metadata.name: video_ltx2_5_i2v
metadata.title: LTX-2.5: Image to Video
metadata.description: Generate video from a single image using LTX-2.5, producing a high-fidelity clip with industry-leading pixel quality and native multishot capability that holds character, environment, and lighting across connected scenes. Ideal for cinematic production, VFX shot creation, and content pipelines requiring fast, locally deployable video generation.

metadata.name: video_ltx2_5_t2v
metadata.title: LTX-2.5: Text to Video
metadata.description: Generate cinematic video from a text prompt using LTX-2.5, a production-ready diffusion model that outputs a single video file with optional spatial upscaling for enhanced resolution. Ideal for film previsualization, commercial storyboards, and high-volume content creation pipelines.

metadata.name: video_ltx2_canny_to_video
metadata.title: LTX-2 Canny to Video
metadata.description: Generate high-quality videos from edge detection (Canny) guidance with synchronized audio-video generation using LTX-2. Features precise edge control, structural consistency, and efficient performance.

metadata.name: video_ltx2_depth_to_video
metadata.title: LTX-2 Depth to Video
metadata.description: Generate high-quality videos from depth maps with synchronized audio-video generation using LTX-2. Features precise depth control, spatial awareness, and efficient performance.

metadata.name: video_ltx2_i2v
metadata.title: LTX-2: Image to Video
metadata.description: Transform static images into dynamic videos with synchronized audio-video generation using LTX-2. Features expressive lip sync, natural motion, and efficient performance.

metadata.name: video_ltx2_i2v_distilled
metadata.title: LTX-2 Image to Video (Distilled)
metadata.description: Transform static images into dynamic videos with synchronized audio-video generation using LTX-2 distilled model. Optimized for faster generation while maintaining quality. Features expressive lip sync, natural motion, and improved speed.

metadata.name: video_ltx2_i2v_lora
metadata.title: Squish Anything with LTX-2 I2V and LoRA
metadata.description: Upload any image to apply the Squish It LoRA effect. Generate a squished animation using the LTX-2 I2V model.

metadata.name: video_ltx2_pose_to_video
metadata.title: LTX-2 Pose to Video
metadata.description: Generate high-quality videos from pose guidance with synchronized audio-video generation using LTX-2. Features precise pose control, expressive motion, and efficient performance.

metadata.name: video_ltx2_t2v
metadata.title: LTX-2 Text to Video
metadata.description: Generate high-quality videos from text prompts with synchronized audio-video generation using LTX-2. Features expressive lip sync, dynamic motion generation, and efficient performance.

metadata.name: video_ltx2_t2v_distilled
metadata.title: LTX-2 Text to Video (Distilled)
metadata.description: Generate high-quality videos from text prompts with synchronized audio-video generation using LTX-2 distilled model. Optimized for faster generation while maintaining quality. Features expressive lip sync, dynamic motion generation, and improved speed.

metadata.name: video_ltx_2_audio_to_video
metadata.title: LTX-2: Audio to Video
metadata.description: Upload an audio file and a starting image frame. Generate a video synchronized to the audio using the LTX-2 model.

metadata.name: video_minimax_h3_fun_controlnet_union
metadata.title: MiniMax H3 Fun ControlNet Union
metadata.description: Generate videos from a pose reference video using MiniMax-H3 with a ControlNet-Union checkpoint, preserving the input's motion and structure while applying your prompt. Ideal for character animation, motion transfer, and choreography visualization projects. This workflow is for pose control only

metadata.name: video_minimax_h3_i2v
metadata.title: MiniMax H3: Image to Video
metadata.description: Turn a starting image into a short, high-quality video clip with MiniMax H3, a unified multimodal model that generates visuals and synchronized audio in a single pass. The workflow takes 1 input image and produces 1 video output, with optional text or reference media to steer motion, style, or sound. Ideal for rapid concept visualization, character-driven animation tests, and creating shareable social media clips with built-in sound design.

metadata.name: video_minimax_h3_i2v_continuation
metadata.title: Image to Video
metadata.description: Start with an image and an empty prompt, then describe the motion, shots, and audio you want MiniMax H3 to generate. The workflow produces one video with synchronized audio and remains fully editable before execution.

metadata.name: video_minimax_h3_multiframe_reference
metadata.title: MiniMax H3: Multiframe Reference
metadata.description: Generate video from multiple still images with MiniMax H3, anchoring up to four reference frames anywhere along the timeline to control motion and composition. Ideal for creating video continuations from existing clips, forcing narrative beats at specific moments, and producing footage with synchronized native audio for cinematic or social media content.

metadata.name: video_minimax_h3_r2v
metadata.title: MiniMax H3: Reference to Video
metadata.description: Generate a new video by feeding MiniMax H3 a reference image, up to nine images, three videos, and three audio clips alongside a text prompt, letting the model match character identity, motion, camera, voice, or style from those sources while producing native stereo audio in a single pass. Output is a single MP4 video at up to 2K resolution and 24fps for roughly 15 seconds. Ideal for character-consistent animation, style-transfer video generation, and audio-synced content creation.

metadata.name: video_minimax_h3_t2v
metadata.title: MiniMax H3: Text to Video
metadata.description: Generate video with native stereo audio directly from a text prompt using MiniMax H3, an omni-modal model that synthesizes voice, sound effects, and music in a single pass. Output is up to 2K resolution, 24fps, and roughly 15 seconds long, with no file inputs required — just a prompt to one video output. Ideal for rapid concept visualization, social media content creation, and audio-synced storytelling.

metadata.name: video_wan2.1_alpha_t2v_14B
metadata.title: Wan2.1 Alpha T2V
metadata.description: Generate text-to-video with alpha channel support for transparent backgrounds and semi-transparent objects.

metadata.name: video_wan2.1_fun_camera_v1.1_1.3B
metadata.title: Wan 2.1 Fun Camera 1.3B
metadata.description: Generate dynamic videos with cinematic camera movements using Wan 2.1 Fun Camera 1.3B model.

metadata.name: video_wan2.1_fun_camera_v1.1_14B
metadata.title: Wan 2.1 Fun Camera 14B
metadata.description: Generate high-quality videos with advanced camera control using the full 14B model

metadata.name: video_wan21_scail2_character_replacement
metadata.title: SCAIL-2: Character Replacement
metadata.description: Upload 1 reference character image and 1 driving video. Generate an animated video of the character matching the driving video's motion. Ideal for character animation, in-video character replacement, and motion transfer projects.

metadata.name: video_wan21_scail2_character_replacement_int8
metadata.title: SCAIL-2 Int8: Character Replacement
